instruction: 请实现一个生成股票报告的网站，提供股票信息和分析。网站要具备搜索和汇总股票信息的功能，并能根据用户需求生成定制化的股票报告。用户应该可以输入股票代码或名称，选择报告的格式和内容，网站会自动生成相应的报告。报告应包含 'Basic Stock Information'、'Market Trends'、'Financial Data' 等内容。把背景色设为 'white'（白色），组件颜色设为 'navy'（藏青色）。网站上所有可见的界面——所有标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文；这些需求里给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文的，必须原样照用。

ui_instruct.task: Verify the stock search functionality by entering a valid stock code.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system returns relevant stock information and analysis corresponding to the entered stock code, displaying details such as basic stock information, market trends, and financial data.

ui_instruct.task: Test the report customization feature by selecting different report formats and content options.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system provides options for various report formats and content customization, enabling users to choose according to their preferences.

ui_instruct.task: Input a stock name instead of a stock code to search for stock information.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website successfully recognizes the stock name, retrieving and displaying the relevant stock information and analysis.

ui_instruct.task: Generate a customized stock report by choosing specific elements to include (e.g., market trends, financial data).
ui_instruct.expected_result: The generated report correctly includes the selected elements, accurately reflecting the user's specified choices.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate through the website and test all buttons function correctly by clicking each of them and back to the homepage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each click on a button leads to the appropriate page or action without any errors, ensuring smooth navigation.

ui_instruct.task: Evaluate the website's form inputs by submitting incomplete or incorrect stock information.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system displays appropriate error messages and guidance on how to correct the input errors, ensuring robust input validation.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'white' as the background color and 'navy' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'white' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'navy', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: 在继续之前，先定下一个演示用的股票池，这样我们看到的数字始终一致——就这八只股票，以后我再加：Argent Micro（ARGN，'Technology'，$84.50，P/E 31.4，'Market Cap' $142B，'Dividend Yield' 0.0%）、Baltic Freight（BLTC，'Industrials'，$23.75，P/E 9.8，$8B，4.2%）、Comet Energy（CMET，'Energy'，$61.20，P/E 12.6，$54B，5.1%）、Driftwood Retail（DRFT，'Consumer Goods'，$9.15，P/E 22.0，$2B，1.8%）、Ember Semiconductor（EMBR，'Technology'，$147.30，P/E 41.7，$210B，0.4%）、Fjord Pharma（FJRD，'Healthcare'，$33.60，P/E 12.6，$18B，2.5%）、Greenline Utilities（GRNL，'Utilities'，$54.80，P/E 15.5，$27B，3.9%）和 Helix Software（HLXS，'Technology'，$58.90，P/E 27.3，$65B，1.1%）。然后给我一个像样的、名为 'Screener' 的页面：行业复选框，只要股票属于任意一个被勾选的行业就算通过；手动输入的最高 P/E 和最低 'Dividend Yield' 输入框，这些条件必须同时满足；一个随每次改动实时更新的 'X of 8 match' 读数；以及可排序的列，按 P/E 排序时并列的用股票代码字母顺序打破。点击结果行应该直接把我带到该股票的报告生成页。我还要两个内置预设——'Dividend Payers' 对应 'Dividend Yield' 至少 2.5%，'Cheap Tech' 对应 P/E 低于 35 的 'Technology' 股票——另外还要能保存我自己命名的预设并在之后重新运行。从现在起的通用规矩：这个应用里任何地方的百分比，无论是今天的 'Dividend Yield' 还是以后加的任何 'Gain' 和 'Weight'，都显示一位小数并带 % 号，比如 4.2%，绝不写成 4.20% 或 4%。
follow_ups.source_feature: Equity screener with multi-criteria filtering (fused with Simply Wall St's curated investing themes as built-in presets)

ui_instruct.task: On the screener, check the Technology and Healthcare sector boxes and type 1.0 into the minimum dividend yield box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Only Fjord Pharma and Helix Software remain in the results — Argent Micro and Ember Semiconductor are excluded for low yield — and the match readout says 2 of 8.

ui_instruct.task: On the screener, clear any active filters, then sort the results by the P/E column in ascending order.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The first three rows are Baltic Freight (9.8), Comet Energy (12.6), then Fjord Pharma (12.6) — the 12.6 tie is broken alphabetically by ticker, so CMET comes before FJRD.

ui_instruct.task: Click the built-in 'Dividend Payers' preset on the screener.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Results show exactly Baltic Freight, Comet Energy, Fjord Pharma, and Greenline Utilities — the boundary stock Fjord Pharma at exactly 2.5% is included.

ui_instruct.task: Click the Comet Energy row in the screener results.
ui_instruct.expected_result: You land in report generation with Comet Energy pre-selected, and generating produces the report for Comet Energy.

ui_instruct.task: Type CMET into the stock search and generate a report with all content options selected.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A report for the searched stock appears, including basic stock information, market trends, and financial data sections.

follow_ups.instruction: 'Screener' 已经开始见效了——现在我需要一个地方存放候选股票。加一个名为 'Watchlist' 的页面，分两个分组：'Core' 和 'Speculative'；初始时把 Comet Energy 和 Fjord Pharma 放在 'Core'，把 Helix Software 放在 'Speculative'，并给 Fjord Pharma 加一条备注，内容是 'watch Q3 margins'。我希望在每一行 'Screener' 结果上和任何生成的报告上都有一个带分组选择器的 'Add to Watchlist' 按钮；如果某只股票已经在列表里，不要再新建一行——只要告诉我它已经保存过了。在 'Watchlist' 页面本身，让我可以编辑备注、在分组之间移动股票以及删除条目。今后还有一条统一样式：只要股票出现在这个应用的任何地方，就在名称前面用一个藏青色（'navy'）小徽章显示它的股票代码，比如 [FJRD] Fjord Pharma——所有地方都要这样，包括我们以后做的功能。
follow_ups.source_feature: Smart alerts and watchlist notifications (the watchlist half, extended with groups and notes)

ui_instruct.task: Open the Watchlist page on a fresh load.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Core group shows Comet Energy and Fjord Pharma, Speculative shows Helix Software, and Fjord Pharma displays the note 'watch Q3 margins'.

ui_instruct.task: From the screener results, click the add-to-watchlist control on the Comet Energy row and choose the Core group, then open the Watchlist page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: No duplicate is created — the watchlist still has exactly three entries with a single Comet Energy row, and the app indicates it was already saved.

ui_instruct.task: On the Watchlist, move Helix Software from Speculative to Core.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Helix Software now appears under Core alongside the other two stocks and no longer appears under Speculative.

ui_instruct.task: In the screener, click add-to-watchlist on the Greenline Utilities row, choose Speculative, then open the Watchlist page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Greenline Utilities appears under the Speculative group on the watchlist.

ui_instruct.task: On the screener, clear any active filters, then sort the results by the P/E column in ascending order.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The first three rows are Baltic Freight (9.8), Comet Energy (12.6), then Fjord Pharma (12.6) — the 12.6 tie is broken alphabetically by ticker, so CMET comes before FJRD.

follow_ups.instruction: 让 'Watchlist' 开始谈钱：加一个名为 'Positions' 的视图，每只被关注的股票都有一个 'Shares' 输入框和一个 'Buy Price' 输入框，并且我一边输入一边重新计算——按股票现价算的 'Market Value'、以美元和百分比表示的 'Gain' 或亏损、每一行在整个 'Portfolio' 中的 'Weight'，以及一行合计。先把我真实的仓位载入进去：50 股 CMET，买入价 $48.00；100 股 FJRD，买入价 $36.50；45 股 HLXS，买入价 $52.25。'Weight' 保留一位小数，但必须始终正好加起来等于 100.0%——当普通四舍五入让你停在 99.9 或 100.1 时，就调整那个最接近向另一边进位的数值。'Shares' 输入框为空或为零，就把那一行从合计里去掉，任何地方都不能出现 NaN 或报错，负数要被拒绝。另外，从现在开始整个应用的默认行为：任何我没有指定排序方式的股票列表，都按股票代码字母顺序显示。
follow_ups.source_feature: Smart alerts and watchlist notifications (watchlist extended into live portfolio position tracking)

ui_instruct.task: Open the Positions view on a fresh load and read the weight column.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Fjord Pharma's weight reads 37.1% (not 37.0%), so the three weights 33.7%, 37.1%, and 29.2% total exactly 100.0%, and total market value shows $9,070.50.

ui_instruct.task: In the Positions view, change Comet Energy's shares from 50 to 60.
ui_instruct.expected_result: After entering 60, CMET's market value updates to $3,672.00 without any save button, the totals row recalculates immediately, and the three weights still add up to exactly 100.0%.

ui_instruct.task: Clear Helix Software's shares box so it is empty.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The HLXS row drops out of the totals — total market value becomes $6,420.00 for the two remaining positions, no NaN or error appears, and the two remaining weights still total exactly 100.0%.

ui_instruct.task: Add Baltic Freight to the watchlist from the screener, then open the Positions view and type 10 into Baltic Freight's shares box and 20.00 into its buy price box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Baltic Freight appears as a position row and shows market value $237.50 with a gain of +18.8%.

ui_instruct.task: From the screener results, click the add-to-watchlist control on the Comet Energy row and choose the Core group, then open the Watchlist page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: No duplicate is created — the watchlist still has exactly three entries with a single Comet Energy row, and the app indicates it was already saved.

follow_ups.instruction: 该做我总在纸上画的那张体检图了。做一个名为 'Ratings' 的页面，把这八只股票在五个维度上按 0-5 打分并排在一起比较。'Value' 直接由 P/E 得出——低于 10 是 5 分，从 10 到 15（不含 15）是 4 分，15 到 25 是 3 分，25 到 35 是 2 分，35 及以上是 1 分；'Dividend' 由 'Dividend Yield' 得出——正好为零是 0 分，低于 1% 是 1 分，从 1 到 2% 是 2 分，2 到 3% 是 3 分，3 到 4.5% 是 4 分，4.5% 及以上是 5 分。'Growth'、'Profitability' 和 'Financial Health' 这三项用我的分析师数据，按这个顺序：Argent 5/3/4、Baltic 2/4/5、Comet 1/4/3、Driftwood 3/2/2、Ember 5/5/4、Fjord 4/3/4、Greenline 1/3/5、Helix 4/5/3。把每只股票的五项得分画成五边形或雷达图，并显示满分 25 的总分和一个字母等级——20 及以上是 A，16 到 19 是 B，12 到 15 是 C，8 到 11 是 D，低于 8 是 E——页面按总分从高到低排列，并列的用股票代码字母顺序打破。顺手在报告生成里加一个 'Health Score' 选项，让生成的报告可以包含该股票的五边形图和等级。
follow_ups.source_feature: Snowflake visual health score

ui_instruct.task: Open the Ratings page and read the ranking from the top.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Baltic Freight ranks first with a total of 20 and grade A (20 lands on the A boundary, not B), and the three stocks tied at 16 appear in the order Ember Semiconductor, Greenline Utilities, Helix Software.

ui_instruct.task: On the Ratings page, find Greenline Utilities and read its Value and Dividend scores.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Greenline's Value score is 3 (P/E 15.5 falls in the 15-to-25 bucket, not the bucket below) and its Dividend score is 4 (yield 3.9%).

ui_instruct.task: Check Comet Energy's entry on the Ratings page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Comet Energy shows Dividend 5 (yield 5.1% clears the 4.5% bucket), Value 4, a total of 17 with grade B, and all five dimensions visible on its pentagon or radar snapshot.

ui_instruct.task: Generate a report for Baltic Freight with the Health Score section included.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The generated report contains a Health Score section showing Baltic Freight's grade A and total of 20 alongside the other selected report content.

ui_instruct.task: On the screener, check the Technology and Healthcare sector boxes and type 1.0 into the minimum dividend yield box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Only Fjord Pharma and Helix Software remain in the results — Argent Micro and Ember Semiconductor are excluded for low yield — and the match readout says 2 of 8.

follow_ups.instruction: 现在做 'Alerts'，让 'Watchlist' 自己盯着自己。我 'Watchlist' 里的任何股票都可以带 'Alerts' 规则——选股票、选指标（'Price'、P/E 或 'Dividend Yield'）、选高于还是低于，再手动输入一个阈值——既能直接从 'Watchlist' 的某一行创建，也能在新的 'Alerts Center' 里创建，那里的股票选择器只提供 'Watchlist' 里已有的股票。规则在创建的那一刻就用该股票当前的数字评估一次，我每次编辑它时再评估一次；高于/低于都是严格的：数值正好等于阈值算作没有触发。先给我三条规则：CMET 的 'Price' 低于 $65（这条已经触发了，价位是 61.20）、FJRD 的 'Dividend Yield' 高于 3%、HLXS 的 P/E 低于 25。'Alerts Center' 显示每一条规则，并带一个状态汇总，说明有多少条是 'Triggered'、多少条是 'Watching'；'Triggered' 的规则可以被忽略并移入单独的 'History' 区，整个过程中汇总数字都要保持准确。
follow_ups.source_feature: Smart alerts and watchlist notifications (the alerts half, evaluated against seeded metrics)

ui_instruct.task: Open the Alerts Center on a fresh load.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The CMET price-below-$65 rule shows triggered, the FJRD and HLXS rules show watching, and the rollup reads 1 triggered and 2 watching.

ui_instruct.task: In the Alerts Center, dismiss the triggered Comet Energy rule.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The rule moves out of the active list into the history section, and the triggered count in the rollup decreases by one while the history section now shows it.

ui_instruct.task: In the Alerts Center, edit the Fjord Pharma yield rule's threshold from 3 to 2.5.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The rule still shows watching — Fjord's yield is exactly 2.5%, and 'above' is strict, so an exactly-equal value does not trigger.

ui_instruct.task: On the Watchlist page, use the set-alert control on the Helix Software row to create a rule for price above 50.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The new rule appears in the Alerts Center attached to Helix Software and immediately shows triggered, since 58.90 is strictly above 50.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Positions view on a fresh load and read the weight column.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Fjord Pharma's weight reads 37.1% (not 37.0%), so the three weights 33.7%, 37.1%, and 29.2% total exactly 100.0%, and total market value shows $9,070.50.

follow_ups.instruction: 加一个 'Earnings Call Highlights' 中心。给这八只股票每只两段简短的、预先写好的最新财报电话会议引语，但要刻意安排用词：'automation' 正好出现在四段引语里——Ember Semiconductor 的两段、Argent Micro 的一段、Helix Software 的一段；'tariffs' 只出现在 Baltic Freight 的引语里；任何引语都不提 'crypto'。然后给我一个搜索框，我一边输入一边实时匹配且不区分大小写，把命中结果按股票分组并高亮匹配到的词，显示每只股票的匹配数和一个总计，按匹配数从多到少排序，数量并列时按股票代码字母顺序排。搜索框为空时就提示我去搜索，某个词零命中时给出明确的 'no results' 提示，绝不能是一片空白。顺便让报告生成里可以包含一个 'Earnings Highlights' 部分，收录该股票的引语。
follow_ups.source_feature: Transcript keyword search

ui_instruct.task: Type automation into the earnings highlights search box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Three stocks appear in the order Ember Semiconductor (2 matches), Argent Micro (1 match), Helix Software (1 match) — most matches first, the 1-1 tie alphabetical by ticker — with a grand total of 4 and every occurrence of 'automation' highlighted.

ui_instruct.task: Type crypto into the earnings highlights search box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A clear no-results message appears — no crash and no blank results area — and any total shown reads zero.

ui_instruct.task: Type TARIFFS in capital letters into the earnings highlights search box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Baltic Freight's matching quote appears despite the different capitalization, and Baltic Freight is the only stock listed.

ui_instruct.task: Type automation into the search box and look at how each result stock is labeled.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each result group shows the ticker in a small navy badge in front of the company name — [EMBR] Ember Semiconductor, [ARGN] Argent Micro, [HLXS] Helix Software.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Ratings page and read the ranking from the top.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Baltic Freight ranks first with a total of 20 and grade A (20 lands on the A boundary, not B), and the three stocks tied at 16 appear in the order Ember Semiconductor, Greenline Utilities, Helix Software.

follow_ups.instruction: 我老是在多份报告之间来回切换来权衡股票——不如给我做一个 'Compare' 工具。让我选两到四只股票，得到并排的列，行包括 'Price'、'Market Cap'、P/E、'Dividend Yield'，以及 'Ratings' 那部分算出的总体 'Health Score' 总分，每次增加或去掉一只股票都立刻重新计算。每一行里最好的要高亮——P/E 最低的胜出，'Dividend Yield' 最高的胜出，'Health Score' 总分最高的胜出——真正并列时，并列的股票都要高亮。最上面放一个每只股票的获胜计数，统计它赢了多少行，并列时参与并列的都算赢；如果只选了一只或一只都没选，就显示一句友好的提示让我多选几只，而不是一个只有一列的或坏掉的表格。
follow_ups.source_feature: Snowflake visual health score (fused with Koyfin's screener metrics into a side-by-side comparison grid)

ui_instruct.task: In the Compare tool, select Comet Energy and Fjord Pharma.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The P/E row highlights both columns (each is 12.6), dividend yield highlights Comet Energy (5.1% vs 2.5%), health score highlights Fjord Pharma (18 vs 17), and the win tally reads 2 for Comet Energy and 2 for Fjord Pharma.

ui_instruct.task: With Comet Energy and Fjord Pharma selected, add Baltic Freight as a third stock.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Highlights recompute instantly: Baltic Freight now solely wins P/E (9.8, so the 12.6 pair loses its highlight) and health (20), Comet Energy keeps yield, and the tally reads Baltic 2, Comet 1, Fjord 0.

ui_instruct.task: Remove selected stocks until only one remains.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Instead of a one-column grid or an error, a friendly prompt appears asking to pick at least two stocks to compare.

ui_instruct.task: Select Comet Energy and Fjord Pharma and look at the dividend yield row.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Yields display with exactly one decimal and a % sign — 5.1% and 2.5% — never 5.10% or 5%.

ui_instruct.task: In the Alerts Center, edit the Fjord Pharma yield rule's threshold from 3 to 2.5.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The rule still shows watching — Fjord's yield is exactly 2.5%, and 'above' is strict, so an exactly-equal value does not trigger.

follow_ups.instruction: 该做外观翻新了，走 Koyfin 风格。在每个页面的页眉放一个浅色/深色切换开关：深色模式换成深藏青色（'deep navy'，#0B1B33）背景配浅色文字，而且我在页面之间切换时这个选择必须保持住。两种主题下，主要操作按钮——'Generate Report'、在 'Screener' 里运行或应用一次筛选、'Add to Watchlist'、保存一条 'Alerts' 规则——都用琥珀色（#F0A92D）配深藏青色（'dark navy'）文字；页面标题和小节标题用大写字母并加宽字母间距；每个卡片或面板都有 12px 圆角和一条细的可见边框。深色模式下也要让股票代码徽章保持清晰可读——给它们更浅的填充色或一个描边，别让它们消失在背景里。这适用于整个应用——报告页、'Screener'、'Watchlist'、'Ratings' 页面、'Alerts Center'，全部都要，不能有做一半的页面。
follow_ups.source_feature: Customizable workspace themes and layout (light/dark theming)

ui_instruct.task: Click the theme toggle on the screener page, then navigate to the Watchlist page and then the Alerts Center.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All three pages render with the deep navy background and light text — the dark theme persists across navigation with no page left on the light background.

ui_instruct.task: In light mode, look at the primary generate button on the report page and the apply/run control on the screener.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Both are amber with dark navy text and match each other, and nearby page titles or section headings render uppercase with wide letter-spacing.

ui_instruct.task: Switch to dark mode and open the Ratings page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The page is dark-themed and still ranks Baltic Freight first with grade A and a total of 20 — the restyle did not break the ratings order.

ui_instruct.task: In dark mode, open the Watchlist page and check the Fjord Pharma entry.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The watchlist cards show 12px rounded corners with a visible border on the dark background, the FJRD ticker badge is still legible, and the note 'watch Q3 margins' still displays.

ui_instruct.task: Type automation into the earnings highlights search box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Three stocks appear in the order Ember Semiconductor (2 matches), Argent Micro (1 match), Helix Software (1 match) — most matches first, the 1-1 tie alphabetical by ticker — with a grand total of 4 and every occurrence of 'automation' highlighted.

follow_ups.instruction: 最后用一个 'Command Center' 把一切收拢，作为落地页——一眼看完，四个磁贴。一个 'Portfolio' 磁贴，显示我 'Positions' 的总 'Market Value' 和整体 'Gain'；一个 'Alerts' 磁贴，显示当前有多少条规则是 'Triggered'、总共多少条；一个 'Top Rated' 磁贴，写出总体 'Health Score' 最好的股票及其等级；还有一个 'Watchlist' 磁贴，显示每个分组的数量。每个磁贴都是通往对应页面的快捷入口，而且数字绝不能过期——如果我忽略了一条 'Alerts' 规则或者改了某只股票的 'Shares' 数量再回来，磁贴必须反映出变化。并且在干净的首次加载时，它就应该用我们已经预置的数据填好，而不是零或占位符。
follow_ups.source_feature: Customizable workspace themes and layout (the dashboard-panel workspace, reshaped into a live rollup command center)

ui_instruct.task: Open the Command Center on a fresh load.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Portfolio tile reads $9,070.50 with overall gain +8.0%, the Alerts tile reads 1 triggered of 3, Top Rated names Baltic Freight with grade A, and the Watchlist tile shows Core 2 and Speculative 1.

ui_instruct.task: Click the Portfolio tile on the Command Center.

target_app_summary: What began as a simple stock-report generator has grown into a full retail-research workstation over a fixed eight-stock demo universe. A multi-criteria screener with built-in and saved presets feeds a grouped watchlist, which in turn powers a live portfolio positions calculator and a strict-threshold alerts workflow; a five-dimension health-score ratings engine flows into generated reports, a side-by-side compare grid, and the landing Command Center that rolls up portfolio value, alert status, top rating, and watchlist counts. Orthogonal growth includes an earnings-call transcript keyword search wired into report sections and a full light/dark theming pass across every surface. The feature graph runs one chain four deep (base app, then screener, then watchlist, then positions, then command center), with the ratings and alerts branches reconverging at the dashboard and the restyle touching five earlier surfaces.

instruction: 请实现一个体育分析网站，提供篮球投注数据与分析。网站应具备'data visualization'、'match prediction'和'betting recommendations'的功能。用户应能浏览篮球数据，查看比赛历史、'team rankings'、'player performance'，并根据分析结果做出明智的投注决策。背景设为 'ghost white'（幽灵白），组件设为 'slate gray'（石板灰）。重要：网站所有可见界面——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示文字和内容——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求中给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文，必须完全按照原样使用。

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the sports data visualization section for basketball.

follow_ups.source_feature: Odds Comparison Across Sportsbooks
follow_ups.instruction: 预测做得很棒，但我习惯比价，所以给我做一个像样的'odds board'页面，把周末的比赛按'Friday'到'Sunday'分组。就加载这六场，主队的独赢赔率按 BetNova、HoopLine、CourtSide 的顺序列出（真实数据源我以后再接）：Fri Celtics @ Knicks，我们的模型给 Knicks 58%，-130 / -125 / -135；Fri Lakers @ Bulls，Bulls 44%，+140 / +145 / +140；Sat Suns @ Heat，Heat 51%，-105 / -110 / -102；Sat Nuggets @ Raptors，Raptors 38%，+170 / +165 / +170；Sun Warriors @ Mavericks，Mavericks 62%，-150 / -155 / -148；Sun Bucks @ Hornets，Hornets 47%，+120 / +118 / +125。高亮每场比赛主队的'best price'并标出是哪家博彩公司给的（如果两家并列最佳，两家都标出来），并显示该'best price'的'implied win probability'，保留一位小数。这个应用里所有内容都要遵守两条固定规范，现在如此，以后新增的东西也一样：赔率一律用带正负号的美式格式（+145、-125，绝不用小数赔率），对阵一律写成 客队 @ 主队。

ui_instruct.task: Open the odds board and read the implied win probability shown for the Celtics @ Knicks game's best price.
ui_instruct.expected_result: It reads 55.6%, derived from the best home price of -125 at HoopLine — not 56.5%, which would mean it was computed from BetNova's -130.

ui_instruct.task: Find the Nuggets @ Raptors game on the odds board and look at how the best price is marked.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The +170 price is flagged as best at both BetNova and CourtSide — both books marked — while HoopLine's +165 is not marked as best.

ui_instruct.task: Look at the Warriors @ Mavericks game on the odds board.
ui_instruct.expected_result: CourtSide's -148 is highlighted as the best home price, not HoopLine's -155 — for negative American odds the number closest to even money is the better payout.

ui_instruct.task: Scan the six games on the odds board.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Every matchup is written away team @ home team (e.g. Celtics @ Knicks) and every price carries an explicit + or - sign in American form, with no decimal odds anywhere.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the team rankings section.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A ranked list of basketball teams is displayed with standings information for each team.

follow_ups.source_feature: Parlay Builder
follow_ups.instruction: 接下来做一个'bet slip'。'odds board'上的每场比赛都要有一个'add-to-slip'的控件，按当前可得的'best price'把主队加进来；'bet slip'需要一个'stake'输入框，'payout'、'profit'、'combined odds'以及模型给出的整张单命中的概率（保留一位小数）都要在每次按键时重新计算——金额精确到分并带美元符号。每场比赛只能有一注（同一场比赛重复添加直接拒绝），最多四注，达到上限时给出明确提示；无效的'stake'——留空、零、负数、字母——要显示错误而不是数字。再加一个清空'bet slip'的控件。

ui_instruct.task: Add the Celtics @ Knicks and Lakers @ Bulls games to the bet slip, then type 10 into the stake box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The slip shows payout $44.10 and profit $34.10 at combined odds of +341, with a 25.5% chance of hitting — not $42.46, which would mean the legs were priced off the first-listed book instead of the best prices (-125 and +145).

ui_instruct.task: Add the Suns @ Heat game to the slip and type abc into the stake box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A clear invalid-stake error appears and no payout figure is shown — no NaN, no $NaN, no stale leftover number presented as valid.

ui_instruct.task: Use the add-to-slip control on the Bucks @ Hornets game twice, then look at the slip.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The slip holds exactly one Hornets leg — the second add is refused or the control is disabled — and the slip's totals reflect a single leg.

ui_instruct.task: On the odds board, add the Nuggets @ Raptors game to the slip and look at the leg's listed price.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The leg shows the Raptors at +170, the same price the board flags as best for that game.

ui_instruct.task: Find the Nuggets @ Raptors game on the odds board and look at how the best price is marked.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The +170 price is flagged as best at both BetNova and CourtSide — both books marked — while HoopLine's +165 is not marked as best.

follow_ups.source_feature: Best Bets Highlighter
follow_ups.instruction: 这才是赚钱的页面。你现在给我的'betting recommendations'只是把模型看好的队伍复述一遍，完全没有赔率概念——把那个功能重建为'Best Bets'：把六支主队按价值'edge'排序——模型给出的获胜概率减去当前'best price'所隐含的概率，以百分点显示，保留一位小数并带符号，比如 +3.2——并给前三名加上徽章。'edge'必须按可以真正买到的'best price'来算，而不是按排在最前面的那家博彩公司；这正是这个页面的意义所在。再加一个'minimum-edge'输入框，我输入一个数字后，列表只保留达到或超过该值的投注，并显示与实际可见条目一致的计数；当没有任何一项达标时，给我一条简单的提示说明，而不是一个空白页面。

ui_instruct.task: Open the Best Bets page on a fresh load and read the top three plays in order.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Top three are Bulls (+3.2), Hornets (+2.6), Knicks (+2.4). The Mavericks are not in the top three — if they appear second, edges were computed from first-listed book prices instead of best prices.

ui_instruct.task: Type 2.5 into the minimum-edge box on the Best Bets page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Exactly two plays remain — Bulls (+3.2) and Hornets (+2.6) — and the displayed count reads 2, matching the visible list; the Knicks at +2.4 are excluded.

ui_instruct.task: Type 9 into the minimum-edge box on the Best Bets page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A friendly nothing-clears-the-bar note is shown — no blank area, no broken list, no crash.

ui_instruct.task: Compare the Suns @ Heat entry on Best Bets with the odds board's highlighted best price for that game.

follow_ups.source_feature: Against-the-Spread (ATS) Record Display
follow_ups.instruction: 咱们来真正下注。我想要从'bet slip'出发的'place-ticket'步骤，先带我到一个'review screen'——包含注单、'stake'、潜在'payout'——然后我再确认；确认后的注单进入'My Tickets'页面，带有 'Won'/'Lost' 的结算控件，全部对着一个起始为 $1,000 的'bankroll'运作：我一确认，'stake'立刻扣除；赢了把全额'payout'打回来，输了什么都不给；'stake'超过'bankroll'则拒绝并给出提示。预先载入一张我已经在跑的注单——$20 押 Mavericks 的独赢，按其'best price'，仍然'pending'——这样'bankroll'一开始就显示 $980。另外从现在起有一条固定规范，所有地方以及以后我们做的任何东西都适用：任何状态都用彩色胶囊标签显示，'pending'或进行中用琥珀色，'Won'或正值用绿色，'Lost'或负值用红色。

ui_instruct.task: On the My Tickets page, settle the pending $20 Mavericks ticket as Won and read the bankroll.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The bankroll reads $1,013.51 — the full $33.51 payout at -148 credited on top of $980. Not $1,013.33 (that used -150 instead of the best price) and not $993.51 (that credited profit without returning the stake).

ui_instruct.task: Add the Celtics @ Knicks and Lakers @ Bulls games to the slip, type 10 into the stake box, place and confirm the ticket, then open My Tickets.

ui_instruct.task: Open the odds board and read the implied win probability shown for the Celtics @ Knicks game's best price.
ui_instruct.expected_result: It reads 55.6%, derived from the best home price of -125 at HoopLine — not 56.5%, which would mean it was computed from BetNova's -130.

follow_ups.source_feature: Player Prop Betting Engine
follow_ups.instruction: 有新闻出来的时候我想推翻模型的判断。做一个覆盖这六场比赛的'adjustments panel'：一个'star-player-sidelined'开关，把主队的获胜概率扣掉 8.0 个百分点；一个'back-to-back'开关，扣掉 3.0；再加一个输入框，让我直接输入自己的概率——超出 0 到 100 的值一律拒绝并给出错误提示。每次开关切换或按键都要立刻改变那场比赛的修正后概率，'Best Bets'排名也要根据我修正后的数字实时重新排序，凡是我动过的投注都带上一个 'adj' 标记。一个'reset'控件把所有东西恢复成模型的原始数值。

ui_instruct.task: Flip the star-player-sidelined switch for the Celtics @ Knicks game, then open the Best Bets rankings.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Knicks' adjusted probability shows 50.0% with an edge of -5.6, the Knicks drop out of the top three, and the top three now read Bulls, Hornets, Mavericks, with an 'adj' marker on the Knicks play.

ui_instruct.task: In the adjustments panel, type 150 into the manual win-probability box for the Suns @ Heat game.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The value is rejected with a validation message and the Heat's probability stays 51.0% — no adjusted value of 150 shows up anywhere.

ui_instruct.task: Flip both the star-player-sidelined and back-to-back switches for the Bucks @ Hornets game, then use the reset control.
ui_instruct.expected_result: With both switches on, the Hornets' adjusted probability reads 36.0% (47 minus 8 minus 3); after reset it returns to 47.0% and no 'adj' markers remain anywhere.

ui_instruct.task: Flip the back-to-back switch for the Lakers @ Bulls game, then check the top of the Best Bets rankings.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Bulls' edge falls to +0.2 (41.0% minus the 40.8% implied by +145) and they lose the top spot; the Hornets (+2.6) move to #1 and the Bulls play carries an 'adj' marker.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Best Bets page on a fresh load and read the top three plays in order.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Top three are Bulls (+3.2), Hornets (+2.6), Knicks (+2.4). The Mavericks are not in the top three — if they appear second, edges were computed from first-listed book prices instead of best prices.

follow_ups.source_feature: Spread Range Filter (fused with Back-to-Back Game Filter and Head-to-Head Historical Matchup Query)
follow_ups.instruction: 大动作：你做的比赛历史查询只告诉我谁赢了，别的什么都没有，所以把它升级成一个'research center'，对照投注市场给每一次交手打分。我选两支球队，档案里每一场过往交手都要有完整拆解——比分、第一支球队的收盘'spread'以及是否打出，总分盘口以及是大分、小分，还是正好落在盘口数字上（'push'就是'push'，绝不并入任何一边），外加第一支球队当时是否处于'back-to-back'。列表上方放一个'summary strip'，显示'straight-up'、'against-the-spread'和'over/under'的'record'，以及总'meetings'中有多少条正在显示；下方放一个手动输入的'spread'最小/最大区间和一个仅'back-to-back'复选框，两者共同筛选列表，这些'record'只按当前可见的行重新计算。载入 Knicks-Celtics 的档案，从 Knicks 一方来看：112-108 胜（-3.5，打出；总分 220，盘口 221.5，小分；休息充分），99-121 负（+2.5，未打出；总分 220，盘口 224.5，小分；'back-to-back'），105-103 胜（+6.5，打出；总分 208，盘口 210.5，小分；'back-to-back'），114-118 负（-1.5，未打出；总分 232，盘口 232，'push'；休息充分），96-94 胜（+4.5，打出；总分 190，盘口 195.5，小分；休息充分），120-130 负（+7.5，未打出；总分 250，盘口 243.5，大分；'back-to-back'）——其他任何组合都显示一条清爽的'no-meetings-on-file'提示。也把它和'odds board'打通：那里的每张比赛卡片都加一个'research link'链接，点进来就预先筛选到这两支球队；而当我查看的这一对也出现在本周末的赛程里时，用横幅标出那场比赛及其'best price'。

ui_instruct.task: In the research center, pick the Knicks and the Celtics and read the summary strip above the meetings list.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Straight-up record 3-3, against-the-spread 3-3, and over/under 1-4-1 — the 232-point game on a 232 line counted as a push, not folded into overs or unders — with all 6 of 6 meetings showing.

ui_instruct.task: With the Knicks-Celtics meetings loaded, check the back-to-back-only box and type 2 and 7 into the min and max spread boxes.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Only the 99-121 and 105-103 meetings remain (the back-to-back games at +2.5 and +6.5 — the rested +4.5 game and the +7.5 game are both excluded) and the ATS record in the summary reads 1-1, recomputed over just the visible rows.

ui_instruct.task: Pick the Knicks and the Celtics in the research center and look for the upcoming-game banner.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A banner shows Friday's Celtics @ Knicks slate game with its best price of -125 at HoopLine.

ui_instruct.task: On the odds board, use the research link on the Warriors @ Mavericks card.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The research center opens pre-filtered to the Warriors and Mavericks, shows the tidy no-meetings-on-file note instead of a blank or broken list, and banners the upcoming Sunday game with its best price of -148 at CourtSide.

ui_instruct.task: On the My Tickets page, settle the pending $20 Mavericks ticket as Won and read the bankroll.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The bankroll reads $1,013.51 — the full $33.51 payout at -148 credited on top of $980. Not $1,013.33 (that used -150 instead of the best price) and not $993.51 (that credited profit without returning the stake).

follow_ups.source_feature: Best Bets Highlighter (extended into edge watch alerts)
follow_ups.instruction: 新闻一动数字，我总是错过入场点。给我做'watch'功能：'Best Bets'上的每一项都有一个'watch'操作，我在里面输入一个'target edge'，被'watch'的投注在列表上直接带一个'watched'标记。一个'Alerts'页面收集我的所有'watch'——每条显示对应的投注、目标值，以及该投注的实时'edge'（包含我的修正）——并按固定规范配一个状态胶囊标签：实时'edge'达到或超过目标时变绿并显示'fired'，还不够时是琥珀色并显示'armed'。无效的目标值——留空、字母——要拒绝并给出提示；每当某次修正改变了某个'edge'，所有'watch'都要立刻重新计算；从'Alerts'页面移除某个'watch'时，'Best Bets'上对应的标记也要一并清除。

ui_instruct.task: On Best Bets, set a watch on the Mavericks play with a target edge of 2.2, then open the Alerts page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Mavericks watch shows a live edge of +2.3 against the 2.2 target and reads fired with a green pill — not armed at +2.0, which is what you'd see if the edge were figured off BetNova's -150 instead of the best-price -148.

ui_instruct.task: Set a watch on the Heat play with a target edge of 1.0, then open the Alerts page and glance back at the Best Bets list.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Heat watch reads armed with an amber pill — its +0.5 edge is short of the 1.0 target — and the Heat play carries a watched marker on the Best Bets list.

ui_instruct.task: Set a watch on the Hornets play with a target edge of 1.0, then remove it from the Alerts page and look back at Best Bets.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The removed watch disappears from the Alerts page and the Hornets play's watched marker is gone from the Best Bets list — removing on one page cleans up the other.

ui_instruct.task: Set a watch on the Bulls play with a target edge of 1.0, then flip the back-to-back switch for the Lakers @ Bulls game in the adjustments panel.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The watch flips from fired to armed on the spot — the Bulls' live edge falls to +0.2 (41.0% minus the 40.8% implied by +145), short of the 1.0 target — and its pill turns from green to amber.

ui_instruct.task: Flip the star-player-sidelined switch for the Celtics @ Knicks game, then open the Best Bets rankings.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Knicks' adjusted probability shows 50.0% with an edge of -5.6, the Knicks drop out of the top three, and the top three now read Bulls, Hornets, Mavericks, with an 'adj' marker on the Knicks play.

follow_ups.source_feature: Against-the-Spread (ATS) Record Display (adapted into a personal performance ledger)
follow_ups.instruction: 注单越攒越多，所以基于'My Tickets'给我做一个'Performance'页面：'net profit'或净亏损、以'profit'除以'total staked'计算并保留一位小数的'ROI'、我的总体输赢'record'，以及'singles'与'parlays'的拆分，再在这些主要数字下面放一个'settled-ticket ledger'，逐条列出每张已结算注单的'stake'和带符号的美元盈亏。只算已结算的注单——'pending'的注单在决出结果之前不计入任何统计——并且把盈亏当作现金处理：每张注单的盈亏在结算的那一刻就锁定到分，页面上的每一项合计都是把这些以分为单位的金额加起来。我一结算什么，所有数字立刻重新计算。先回填三张已结算注单，免得第一天页面是空的：一张 $25 的'singles'，押 Mavericks 的'best price'，赢了；一张 $10 的'parlays'，押 Knicks 和 Bulls 的'best price'，输了；一张 $15 的'singles'，押 Hornets 的'best price'，赢了。

ui_instruct.task: Open the Performance page on a fresh load and read the headline figures.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Net profit +$25.64, ROI 51.3%, and an overall record of 2-1 — not +$24.67 / 49.3%, which would mean the wins were priced off first-listed books instead of the best prices (-148 and +125).

ui_instruct.task: On My Tickets, settle the pending $20 Mavericks ticket as Lost, then open the Performance page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Net profit drops to +$5.64, ROI reads 8.1% ($5.64 over $70 now staked), the record reads 2-2, and the singles split reads 2-1.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Performance page while the $20 Mavericks ticket is still pending and read the singles-versus-parlays split and the total staked.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Singles 2-0, parlays 0-1, and total staked $50 — the pending $20 ticket is not counted in any figure on the page.

ui_instruct.task: Settle the pending $20 Mavericks ticket as Won on My Tickets, then open the Performance page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Net profit rises to +$39.15 (up exactly $13.51), the record reads 3-1, the singles split reads 3-0, and ROI reads 55.9%.

ui_instruct.task: In the research center, pick the Knicks and the Celtics and read the summary strip above the meetings list.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Straight-up record 3-3, against-the-spread 3-3, and over/under 1-4-1 — the 232-point game on a 232 line counted as a push, not folded into overs or unders — with all 6 of 6 meetings showing.

follow_ups.source_feature: Best Bets Highlighter (visual value-highlighting language)
follow_ups.instruction: 该换新形象了——'ghost white'（幽灵白）这套外观已经过时了，而且我不想要一个刷了一半漆的应用。所有地方都要改：页面标题改为大写并左对齐；像'add-to-slip'和结算按钮这类主要操作控件换成深祖母绿（'emerald'）；比赛卡片和注单卡片统一采用圆角外观（约 12px）并带可见边框；所有正值数字——'edge'、'profit'——用绿色显示，所有负值用红色；博彩公司名称在任何显示赔率的地方都以小号大写标签呈现。把这一整套应用到'odds board'、'Best Bets'、'My Tickets'、'research center'、'Performance'页面和原来的'team rankings'页面——每一个页面都要，保持一致。

ui_instruct.task: Open the Best Bets page and look at the Bulls play's edge figure.
ui_instruct.expected_result: It reads +3.2 and is rendered in green, per the positive-numbers-green rule of the rebrand.

ui_instruct.task: Open the odds board, then the research center, then the team rankings page, and look at each page title.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All three page titles are uppercase and left-aligned — including the original team rankings page, not just the newer pages.

ui_instruct.task: On My Tickets, look at the pending $20 Mavericks ticket card, then find the Warriors @ Mavericks game on the odds board.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The ticket card has rounded corners with a visible border and its pending status is still an amber pill; on the odds board, each of that game's three prices carries its sportsbook name as a small uppercase tag (BETNOVA, HOOPLINE, COURTSIDE).

ui_instruct.task: Open the Performance page and check how the backfilled profit and loss figures are colored.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The positive net profit (+$25.64) renders in green and the lost parlay's -$10.00 line in the settled-ticket ledger renders in red, with the page title uppercase and left-aligned.

ui_instruct.task: On Best Bets, set a watch on the Mavericks play with a target edge of 2.2, then open the Alerts page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The Mavericks watch shows a live edge of +2.3 against the 2.2 target and reads fired with a green pill — not armed at +2.0, which is what you'd see if the edge were figured off BetNova's -150 instead of the best-price -148.

target_app_summary: The basketball prediction site grows into a full line-shopping and bet-management platform. A pinned six-game weekend odds board carrying the base model's win probabilities and home moneylines at three sportsbooks becomes the data spine: a parlay slip books legs at best prices, the base betting-recommendations feature is rebuilt into a Best Bets value-edge ranking, an adjustments panel lets users override model probabilities and re-rank the edges live, and watch alerts with typed target edges flip between fired and armed as those numbers move. A ticket-placement workflow with a bankroll feeds a Performance analytics page (ROI, records, singles-vs-parlays, a cent-locked settled-ticket ledger), while the base match-history lookup is upgraded into a matchup research center grading past meetings against closing lines with ATS/over-under records and push handling, deep-linked from the board. A final emerald rebrand sweeps every surface including the original rankings page. The graph roots at the base app: predictions -> board -> slip -> tickets -> performance (5 deep from T1) and board -> edge finder -> adjustments -> watch alerts.

global_rules.rule: Odds are always displayed in American form with an explicit sign (+145, -125), never as decimal odds, everywhere in the app.
Matchups are always written as away team @ home team on every surface.
Any status anywhere is shown as a colored pill: amber for pending/in-progress, green for won/positive, red for lost/negative.

instruction: 请实现一个太阳能仪表盘，用于展示 'real-time data' 和 'historical data'。仪表盘要具备 'real-time data' 展示、'historical data' 查询和图表分析等功能。用户应该能查看 'solar power generation'、'power consumption' 和 'battery percentage' 这些 'real-time data'，并通过查询 'historical data' 来查看趋势。背景色设置为 'honeydew'，组件使用 'dark olive green'。网站上可见的整个界面——包括所有标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求里给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文，必须原样照用。

ui_instruct.task: Verify the display of real-time solar power generation data.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The dashboard should show a continuously updating numerical value or graph indicating the current solar power generation.

ui_instruct.task: Test the display of real-time power consumption data.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The dashboard should present a real-time updating figure or chart that accurately reflects the current power consumption levels.

ui_instruct.task: Validate the real-time display of battery percentage.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The dashboard should continuously update to show the current percentage of battery charge, clearly and accurately.

ui_instruct.task: Check the functionality of querying historical data from the solar power generation data by a start and end date.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Users should be able to input a start and end date, and the dashboard should return relevant data trends for the selected period.

ui_instruct.task: Test the navigation functionality between the real-time data display and historical data query sections.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Users should be able to smoothly navigate between sections using clearly labeled tabs or buttons without page reload issues.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'honeydew' as the background color and 'dark olive green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'honeydew' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark olive green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.source_feature: Module-level alert system (panel-level performance view)
follow_ups.instruction: 仪表盘挺不错，不过现在我想看到真实的光伏板——就是那些发电数字背后的光伏板。给我一个 'Panels' 页面，列出每块光伏板的所属阵列、额定瓦数和本周发电量，再加上每个阵列以及 'fleet' 的汇总——发电量和额定总瓦数——先按这六块来，以后我再加：'South' 阵列有 'Peak 1'（400 W，本周 14.00 kWh）、'Ridge West'（400 W，13.20 kWh）和 'Ridge East'（350 W，11.55 kWh）；'East' 阵列有 'Gable 1'（350 W，9.80 kWh）、'Corner 2'（300 W，9.00 kWh）和 'Chimney 3'（300 W，5.40 kWh）。按 'yield' 排序——也就是每 kW 额定容量对应的本周 kWh，保留一位小数——最好的排在最前，两块光伏板 'yield' 相同时就按字母顺序排。还有一条规则适用于整个应用，现在和以后新增的部分都一样：能量始终显示为 kWh 并保留两位小数，所以 'Corner 2' 显示 9.00 kWh，绝不能是 9 kWh。

ui_instruct.task: Open the Panels page and read the ranked panel list from top to bottom.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The order is Peak 1 (yield 35.0), Ridge East (33.0), Ridge West (33.0), Corner 2 (30.0), Gable 1 (28.0), Chimney 3 (18.0) — Ridge East sits above Ridge West on the alphabetical tiebreak, and Corner 2 sits above Gable 1 even though Gable 1 produced more kWh.

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, compare the rows for Corner 2 and Gable 1.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Corner 2 (yield 30.0) is ranked above Gable 1 (yield 28.0) despite Gable 1's higher weekly output (9.80 kWh vs 9.00 kWh), showing the ranking uses kWh per rated kW rather than raw output.

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, find the rollup figures for the South array, the East array, and the whole fleet.
ui_instruct.expected_result: South shows 38.75 kWh, East shows 24.20 kWh, and the fleet shows 62.95 kWh with a total rated capacity of 2,100 W — the two array totals sum exactly to the fleet total.

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, read Corner 2's weekly output figure.
ui_instruct.expected_result: It reads exactly 9.00 kWh — two decimals with the kWh unit, not 9 kWh or 9.0 kWh — and the other energy figures on the page also carry two decimals.

ui_instruct.task: In the historical data section, enter a start date and an end date to run a query.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A chart or trend view for the selected period is displayed without errors.

follow_ups.source_feature: Financial Payback Calculator
follow_ups.instruction: 很棒。接下来：一个 'savings calculator' 页面——我输入我的 'electricity rate'（美元每 kWh）和 'system cost'，它算出 'yearly savings' 和 'payback'。用 'Panels' 页面上 'fleet' 的本周总量乘以 52 作为全年 kWh，金额用美元显示并保留两位小数，'payback' 按年和月给出，不满一个月的部分向上取整。我一边输入它就要一边重新计算，不要提交按钮。还有一条从现在开始适用于应用任何地方的规矩：如果我输入了不合法的内容——字母、零 'rate'、负数——不要清空结果，保留上一次的正确数字，只显示一条关于错误输入的小提示。

ui_instruct.task: On the savings calculator, type 0.30 into the electricity rate field and 9000 into the system cost field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Yearly savings show $982.02 (3,273.40 kWh x $0.30) and the payback reads 9 years, 2 months — the partial month rounds up, so not 9 years 1 month and not a bare decimal like 9.2 years.

ui_instruct.task: Type 0.40 into the rate field and 9000 into the cost field, then change the rate to 0.20.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The results update immediately as the rate changes with no submit step, and yearly savings at 0.20 read exactly half of what they showed at 0.40 ($654.68 vs $1,309.36).

ui_instruct.task: Type 0.30 into the rate field and 9000 into the cost field, then replace the rate with the letters abc.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The last good results (yearly savings $982.02, payback 9 years 2 months) stay on screen with a small note about the invalid input — no blanked results, no NaN, no crash.

ui_instruct.task: Check the annual generation figure the calculator is using, then open the Panels page and read the fleet weekly rollup.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The calculator's annual figure is 3,273.40 kWh, exactly 52 times the 62.95 kWh fleet weekly total shown on the Panels page.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Panels page and read the ranked panel list from top to bottom.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The order is Peak 1 (yield 35.0), Ridge East (33.0), Ridge West (33.0), Corner 2 (30.0), Gable 1 (28.0), Chimney 3 (18.0) — Ridge East sits above Ridge West on the alphabetical tiebreak, and Corner 2 sits above Gable 1 even though Gable 1 produced more kWh.

follow_ups.source_feature: Module-level alert system
follow_ups.instruction: 我的 'Chimney 3' 光伏板让我有点担心，所以做一个 'alert center'。里面有一个规则区域，我在那里输入 'yield' 阈值——任何一块光伏板的本周 'yield' 严格低于该值就触发一条警报，正好等于这个数值仍然算正常，而且每块光伏板只有一条警报，即使有几条规则都命中它——再加上一个未处理警报列表和一个单独的已处理记录，每条警报要写明光伏板名称和它的 'yield'。先预设一条 25.0 的规则。当我确认处理一条警报时，先让我确认一次，然后它移到已处理记录里，并在导航上直接显示有多少条警报尚未处理。对了，从现在起整个应用都这样：任何状态都要有一个彩色圆点加上旁边的一个词——红点 'Active'，绿点 'Resolved'，诸如此类——绝不能只用颜色。

ui_instruct.task: In the alert center's rules area, type 33.0 as a new rule threshold and add the rule.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Exactly 3 alerts are active — Corner 2, Gable 1, and Chimney 3 — while Ridge East and Ridge West (sitting exactly at 33.0) are not flagged, Chimney 3 appears only once even though the pre-set 25.0 rule also catches it, and the navigation badge reads 3.

ui_instruct.task: Open the alert center on a fresh load and look at the active alerts list.
ui_instruct.expected_result: One alert is active — Chimney 3, caught by the pre-set 25.0 rule — shown with a red dot plus the word Active, and the navigation badge shows 1.

ui_instruct.task: Acknowledge the Chimney 3 alert and confirm when asked.
ui_instruct.expected_result: A confirmation step appears before anything moves; after confirming, Chimney 3 leaves the active list, shows up in the resolved log with a green dot plus the word Resolved, and the navigation badge drops to 0.

ui_instruct.task: Read the yield figure shown on Chimney 3's alert, then open the Panels page and find Chimney 3's row.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Both show the same 18.0 yield, and Chimney 3 sits at the bottom of the panel ranking — consistent with it being the only panel below the 25.0 rule.

ui_instruct.task: On the savings calculator, type 0.30 into the electricity rate field and 9000 into the system cost field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Yearly savings show $982.02 (3,273.40 kWh x $0.30) and the payback reads 9 years, 2 months — the partial month rounds up, so not 9 years 1 month and not a bare decimal like 9.2 years.

follow_ups.source_feature: CSV Data Export
follow_ups.instruction: 我老是把光伏板的数字一个个抄到邮件里——给我一个 'report builder'。让我勾选要包含哪些光伏板，并提供 'South'、'East'、'everything' 和 'none' 这几个快捷按钮，然后在页面上直接生成一份我可以复制的纯文本报告：包含多少块光伏板、它们的合计发电量、平均 'yield'——就把各光伏板的 'yield' 数值取平均，保留一位小数，不要按光伏板功率加权——以及按 'yield' 排出的最好和最差的光伏板，并列时按字母顺序。如果什么都没勾选，就友好地说明一下，而不是显示零或者 NaN 这种垃圾，而且我一改勾选，报告就要立刻重新生成。

ui_instruct.task: On the Panels page, find the rollup figures for the South array, the East array, and the whole fleet.
ui_instruct.expected_result: South shows 38.75 kWh, East shows 24.20 kWh, and the fleet shows 62.95 kWh with a total rated capacity of 2,100 W — the two array totals sum exactly to the fleet total.

follow_ups.source_feature: Actual vs. Estimated Generation Comparison
follow_ups.instruction: 我怎么知道系统运行得是否正常？在 'historical chart' 上加一条我可以开关的 'expected baseline'，也就是预期发电量的参考线：我输入每天的 'peak sun hours'——初始为 5.0——预期值由 'Panels' 页面上 'fleet' 的额定容量乘以这些小时数逐天算出。在图表旁边显示一个性能数字，即本周实际值除以本周预期值的百分比，保留一位小数，旁边配一个状态读数：90 及以上是 'Healthy'，75 到 90 是 'Watch'，低于 75 是 'Fault'。我一改小时数，所有内容都要立刻跟着变。

ui_instruct.task: With the baseline on, change the peak sun hours to 8.0.

follow_ups.source_feature: Environmental Benefits view (CO2 and tree-equivalent impact statistics)
follow_ups.instruction: 现在给我看让人高兴的数字：一个 'environmental impact' 页面。取 'Panels' 页面上 'fleet' 的本周总量，按每 kWh 0.4 kg 换算成减少的 CO2——本周的数值再加上全年预测——并显示它所依据的全年能量，这个数必须和 'savings calculator' 使用的本周乘以 52 的数字完全一致。CO2 以 kg 显示并保留两位小数，但只要某个数值达到 1,000 kg，就改用吨并保留两位小数，而不是一个四位数的 kg 怪物。再给我一行树木——按一棵树每年吸收 21 kg CO2 计算，用全年 CO2 除以它，然后向下取整到整棵树，不要出现半棵树。还要把本周的影响按阵列拆开：'South' 和 'East' 各自的 kg 和占比百分比，保留一位小数，这两个占比加起来必须是 100。

ui_instruct.task: Open the environmental impact page and read the weekly and annual CO2 figures.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The weekly figure reads 25.18 kg (62.95 kWh x 0.4) and the annual projection reads 1.31 t — the 1,309.36 kg crosses the 1,000 kg line so it shows in tonnes with two decimals, not as 1,309.36 kg and not rounded to 1.3 t.

ui_instruct.task: On the environmental impact page, read the tree equivalence line.
ui_instruct.expected_result: It reads 62 trees — the annual 1,309.36 kg divided by 21 and rounded down to a whole number, not 62.4 trees and not the 1 tree a weekly-based calculation would give.

ui_instruct.task: On the environmental impact page, read the per-array impact split.
ui_instruct.expected_result: South shows 15.50 kg at 61.6% and East shows 9.68 kg at 38.4% — the two kg figures sum exactly to the weekly 25.18 kg and the two shares add up to exactly 100.

ui_instruct.expected_result: Both read exactly 3,273.40 kWh — the impact page and the calculator share the same 52-week projection of the panels page's 62.95 kWh fleet weekly total, shown with two decimals.

follow_ups.source_feature: Power Flow Diagram
follow_ups.instruction: 现在是好玩的：一个实时 'power flow' 页面——光伏板、电池、家庭和电网的动画示意图，每条流向上标出当前数值，以 kW 显示并保留两位小数。给我三个可以调的输入：以百分比表示的 'sun level'、以 kW 表示的 'home load'，以及 'battery percent'，默认 60。发电量是 'Panels' 页面上 'fleet' 的额定容量按 'sun level' 缩放后的结果；盈余先给电池充电直到 100，然后溢出到电网，而缺口则让电池放电到 20 这个下限，之后才从电网取电。不管我输入什么，数字都必须平衡——光伏板产生的加上电池或电网补充的，始终等于家庭消耗的加上被储存或送出的，我一边输入就一边实时更新。

ui_instruct.task: On the power flow page, type 100 into the sun level and 1.50 into the home load, leaving the battery at its default 60.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Generation reads 2.10 kW, the home takes 1.50 kW, the battery charges at 0.60 kW, and the grid shows 0.00 kW — the flows add up exactly.

ui_instruct.task: Type 50 into the sun level and 3.00 into the home load, leaving the battery at 60.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Generation reads 1.05 kW and the 1.95 kW shortfall is covered by the battery discharging, with the grid at 0.00 kW — generation plus battery discharge equals the home's 3.00 kW.

ui_instruct.task: Type 100 into the battery percent, 100 into the sun level, and 1.00 into the home load.
ui_instruct.expected_result: With the battery already full, the 1.10 kW surplus flows entirely to the grid as export and the battery flow reads 0.00 kW.

ui_instruct.task: Type 100 into the sun level on the power flow page, then open the Panels page and read the fleet's total rated capacity.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The simulator's full-sun generation of 2.10 kW matches the 2,100 W rated capacity in the fleet rollup.

ui_instruct.task: On the historical chart, toggle the expected baseline on and leave peak sun hours at the default 5.0.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The performance readout shows 85.6% (62.95 kWh actual vs 73.50 kWh expected for the week) with a Watch health read — not 85.7%, not 86%, and not Healthy or Fault.

follow_ups.source_feature: System Health Status Indicator
follow_ups.instruction: 把这些汇总到一个 'System Health' 页面上，用一个分数表示。从 100 分起，'alert center' 里每有一条未处理警报就扣 15 分，如果 'fleet' 的平均 'yield'——各光伏板 'yield' 数值的简单平均——低于 30.0，就再扣 10 分。90 分及以上显示 'Healthy'，75 到 89 是 'Watch'，低于 75 是 'Fault'，而且我想看到扣分明细，好知道为什么扣分，再加上每条未处理警报一行待办事项，如果 'fleet' 的 'yield' 偏低也在扣我的分，就再给它一行。当我去确认处理一条警报后，等我回到这个页面时分数应该已经更新好了。

ui_instruct.task: Open the System Health page on a fresh load and read the score and its breakdown.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The score is 75 with a Watch health read (75 lands in Watch, not Fault), broken down as 100 minus 15 for the one active alert (Chimney 3) minus 10 because the fleet's average yield of 29.5 is under 30.0.

ui_instruct.task: On the System Health page, read the to-do list.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Exactly two to-do lines show — one for the active Chimney 3 alert and one for the low fleet average yield — matching the two deductions in the breakdown.

ui_instruct.task: Compare the displayed score with the deduction lines on the System Health page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The score equals 100 minus the sum of the listed deductions — the breakdown shown is internally consistent with the headline number.

ui_instruct.task: Go to the alert center, acknowledge the Chimney 3 alert and confirm, then return to the System Health page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The score rises to exactly 90 with a Healthy read (90 is the Healthy boundary), and the to-do list drops to a single line about the low fleet yield.

ui_instruct.task: Open the environmental impact page and read the weekly and annual CO2 figures.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The weekly figure reads 25.18 kg (62.95 kWh x 0.4) and the annual projection reads 1.31 t — the 1,309.36 kg crosses the 1,000 kg line so it shows in tonnes with two decimals, not as 1,309.36 kg and not rounded to 1.3 t.

target_app_summary: The solar dashboard has grown into a full home-solar operations platform. A panel fleet registry with per-array rollups and yield rankings became the backbone: it feeds a live-typing savings and payback calculator, a threshold-based alert workflow with rules, an active list and a resolved log, a copyable panel report builder, an expected-vs-actual performance overlay on the historical chart, an environmental impact page that converts fleet output into CO2 avoided and tree equivalents, a physics-honest power flow simulator, and finally a System Health score that reconciles the alert center and fleet yields into one graded number with to-dos. A design refresh mid-way moved the whole app from honeydew to a cream-and-amber card system. The graph is hub-and-spoke around the registry (T2, itself built off the base dashboard, feeds every later turn) with one deep chain rooted at the base — base to registry to alert center to health score — so early breakage compounds; three app-wide conventions (two-decimal kWh, invalid-input-never-blanks, dot-plus-word statuses) are tested silently on every new surface.

edges.what: panels page breaks the base dashboard's generation figures down per panel
fleet weekly total (62.95 kWh) x 52 drives annual savings
panel yield figures evaluated against alert rules
selected panels' outputs and yields aggregated into report
fleet rated capacity and weekly actual feed expected baseline and ratio
overlays baseline on the base historical chart
restyles the base dashboard
restyles the panels page
restyles the calculator page
restyles the alert center
fleet weekly total (62.95 kWh) converts into all CO2 figures
annual CO2 rides on the calculator's 3,273.40 kWh weekly-times-52 basis
full-sun generation equals fleet rated 2.10 kW
score deducts 15 per active alert; acknowledging updates it
fleet average yield (29.5) triggers the under-30 penalty

global_rules.rule: Energy values are always displayed as kWh with exactly two decimals (9.00 kWh, 62.95 kWh) everywhere in the app.
Invalid input never blanks a result anywhere: the last valid output stays on screen alongside a small note about the bad input.
Every status or health indicator is a colored dot plus a word (red dot 'Active', green dot 'Resolved'), never color alone.

instruction: 请实现一个基于文本的策略网页游戏，玩家可以挑选种族、管理资源、升级并进行战斗。游戏应当包含多个页面，包括 'base page'、'ranking page'、'store'、'train page'、'workers page'、'upgrades page'、'bank page'、'messages page' 和 'reports page'。玩家可以从四个种族中挑选：'Humans'、'Dragonborns'、'Elves' 和 'Dwarfs'，每个种族都有独特的属性。玩家可以管理 'Gold'、'Iron'、'Wood' 和 'Wheat' 等资源，并可以升级自己的城市、工人和士兵。网站设计请使用 'seashell' 作为背景，用 'crimson' 作为内容区块的颜色。网站上所有可见的界面——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求里给出的功能、页面和按钮名称都是英文，必须原样照用。

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the "Choose Race" page and select each race (Humans, Dragonborns, Elves, Dwarfs) one by one and back to the homepage after selecting for another select.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each click on a race should display specific attributes unique to that race, and the selection should be confirmed on the page.

ui_instruct.task: On the base page, attempt to allocate resources (gold, iron, wood, wheat) to upgrade the city.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The resources should be deducted from the total, and an upgrade confirmation message should appear with visible changes to the city level or attributes.

ui_instruct.task: Visit the "Ranking Page" and verify the rank listing of players.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The page should display a sorted list of players by rank, with accurate and clear presentation relevant to their performance metrics.

ui_instruct.task: Go to the "Store" and purchase an item using available resources.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The selected item should be removed from the store and added to your inventory, with the appropriate deduction in resources.

ui_instruct.task: Access the "Train Page" and begin training workers or soldiers.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Training should commence with a status update visible, and there should be an indication of resource consumption related to this activity.

ui_instruct.task: Navigate to the "Workers Page" and assign a task to workers.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The task should be acknowledged by the system with relevant feedback on expected completion, and any resource costs should be visibly deducted.

ui_instruct.task: Visit the "Upgrades Page" and attempt to upgrade a soldier.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The upgrade should succeed, show updated soldier stats, and the necessary resources should be spent.

ui_instruct.task: Access the "Bank Page" and deposit gold.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The deposited gold should reflect in the bank balance, deducting from available on-hand funds with confirmation of the transaction.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'seashell' as the background color and 'crimson' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'seashell' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'crimson', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: 'bank page' 现在完全是摆设——在里面做一个像样的 'merchant exchange'。把我的 'stockpile' 设为正好 2,500 Gold、1,800 Iron、1,200 Wood 和 900 Wheat，并让我按 3 Iron、4 Wood 或 5 Wheat 换 1 枚 Gold 的比率把 Iron、Wood 或 Wheat 换成 Gold，商人抽成 10%——先扣掉他的抽成再取整，并且始终向下取整到整数 Gold，所以 100 Iron 应该换出 30 Gold，而不是 29。Gold 预览必须在我输入数量时实时更新，并且要拒绝负数、无效输入，或任何超过我实际持有量的数量。另外这是整个游戏的一条通用规则，现在以及以后新增的任何功能都适用：任何会消耗或转换我资源的操作，都要先把确切的数字展示给我，并等待我确认。
follow_ups.source_feature: Merchant / Resource Trading via Bank

ui_instruct.task: Go to the bank page, choose the iron-to-gold exchange, and type 100 into the amount field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The live preview shows exactly 30 gold to be received (the 10% merchant cut is applied before rounding down), not 29 or 33.

ui_instruct.task: On the bank page's merchant exchange, type 2000 into the iron-to-gold amount field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The exchange refuses the amount because only 1,800 iron is held: an error indication appears and no gold conversion is offered.

ui_instruct.task: On the wood-to-gold exchange, type 30 into the amount field, then add a 0 to make it 300.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The preview updates while typing without any submit action: it reads 6 gold at 30 wood, then 67 gold at 300 wood (cut applied before rounding down each time).

ui_instruct.task: Convert 100 iron to gold on the bank page and complete the action.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Before anything changes, a confirmation showing the exact numbers (100 iron for 30 gold) appears and requires approval; after confirming, the stockpile reads 2,530 gold and 1,700 iron.

ui_instruct.task: Go to the race selection and choose Dwarfs.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Dwarfs is shown as the selected race and its unique attributes are displayed.

follow_ups.instruction: 把 'reports page' 变成一份真正的战争编年史，只加载以下正好六场战斗，别的都不要——以后我会再记录：'Day 2'，击败 Ashen Elves，损失 12 名士兵，掠夺 380 Gold 和 220 Iron；'Day 4'，击败 Grimfang Horde，损失 18 名，265 Gold 和 340 Iron；'Day 5'，击败 Stonebeard Clan，损失 9 名，410 Gold 和 95 Iron；'Day 7'，击败 Silverpine Sentinels，损失 21 名，505 Gold 和 130 Iron；同样是 'Day 7'，输给 Duskwing Riders，阵亡 33 名，没有战利品；'Day 9'，输给 Ironhold Clan，阵亡 40 名，什么都没有。按天数从新到旧排列，两场战斗在同一天时，按对手名称的字母顺序排。顶部我要一个汇总：历史总的 'win rate'，以及只统计最近三个战斗日的 'recent form' 比率——注意是天数，不是场次，所以那几天里的每一场战斗都要算进去（取整数百分比，所以 6 场中的 4 场显示为 67%）、掠夺到的 Gold 和 Iron 的总量、损失士兵的总数，还有我全部的 Iron 按你做的那个商人能换多少 Gold——同样是 3 Iron 换 1 Gold 的比率，同样是先扣抽成再向下取整的算法。还有两条从现在起适用于整个游戏的通用规则：战斗结果始终以绿色的 'Victory' 徽章或红色的 'Defeat' 徽章显示；任何与时间有关的内容都标记成像 'Day 9' 这样的游戏天数，绝不用真实的日历日期。
follow_ups.source_feature: Combat Reports with Debris Fields

ui_instruct.task: Open the reports page and read the chronicle's summary figures.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All-time win rate reads 67% while recent form reads 50% (the three most recent battle days are Day 5, 7 and 9, which take in four battles — two wins, two defeats — not the 33% a last-three-battles reading would give); total plunder reads 1,560 gold and 785 iron, and total soldiers lost reads 133.

ui_instruct.task: Open the reports page and read the order of the six battle entries from top to bottom.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Ironhold Clan (Day 9) first, then the two Day 7 battles with Duskwing Riders before Silverpine Sentinels (alphabetical tiebreak, not the order they were fought in), then Stonebeard Clan (Day 5), Grimfang Horde (Day 4), and Ashen Elves (Day 2) last.

ui_instruct.task: Scroll through the six battle entries on the reports page.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each entry carries an outcome badge — green Victory on the four wins, red Defeat on Duskwing Riders and Ironhold Clan — and each is stamped in game-day form like 'Day 7', with no calendar dates anywhere.

ui_instruct.task: Note the iron-haul gold value shown in the chronicle summary, then go to the bank's merchant exchange and type 785 into the iron-to-gold amount field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Both places show the same figure: 235 gold (785/3 with the 10% cut taken before rounding down — not 234).

ui_instruct.task: Go to the bank page, choose the iron-to-gold exchange, and type 100 into the amount field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The live preview shows exactly 30 gold to be received (the 10% merchant cut is applied before rounding down), not 29 or 33.

follow_ups.instruction: 我们打赢的那些战场上还铺满了残骸，所以让我派出回收队。编年史里每一场打赢的战斗都会有一个 'salvage option'——打输的战斗没有，那些战场在敌人手里——这个选项会一步步引导我：我输入要派出多少工人（最少 5 名，每名花费 15 Wheat），一个复核步骤列出全部收获和 Wheat 账单，我批准之后货物就进入我的 'stockpile'。一个战场的收获是该场战斗掠夺 Gold 的 20% 向下取整，再加上我在那里每损失 1 名士兵得 5 Iron。某个战场被搜刮干净后，把它标记为 'salvaged'，别让我重复执行。

ui_instruct.task: Open the reports page and read the chronicle's summary figures.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All-time win rate reads 67% while recent form reads 50% (the three most recent battle days are Day 5, 7 and 9, which take in four battles — two wins, two defeats — not the 33% a last-three-battles reading would give); total plunder reads 1,560 gold and 785 iron, and total soldiers lost reads 133.

follow_ups.instruction: 我想要一个 'Hall of Plaques' 页面来炫耀——三块 'Plaques'，每块依次攀升 'Wood'、'Bronze'、'Silver' 和 'Gold' 等级。'Plunderer' 是战斗中掠夺的 Gold 总量，等级线在 500 / 1,000 / 1,600 / 2,500——而且只算战斗掠夺，回收得到的收获属于拾荒，不计入其中。'Warlord' 是打赢的场数，等级线在 1 / 3 / 5 / 8；'Veteran' 是损失士兵的总数，等级线在 50 / 100 / 200 / 400。每一块都要显示我当前所处的等级，以及还差多少才能达到下一级。

ui_instruct.task: On the bank page's merchant exchange, type 2000 into the iron-to-gold amount field.

follow_ups.instruction: 给我做一个 'battle simulator' 页面，随着我每一次按键实时重演整场战斗——不要提交按钮，推演结果随着我的输入自动重新生成。我输入我的进攻方人数、防守方人数，以及一个 -25 到 25 之间的幸运百分比（超出这个范围或不是数字就用提示信息拒绝）。士气等于防守方除以进攻方再乘以 100，四舍五入并限制在 30 到 100 之间，只根据我输入的人数计算一次——并在推演中显示出来。战斗随后按回合进行，直到一方被全歼：每个回合防守方损失我当前有效战力的四分之一并向上取整——也就是我剩余的进攻方人数乘以士气除以 100 再乘以（1 + 幸运/100）——同时我损失他们当前人数的四分之一，并计入他们固定的 10% 防御加成，同样向上取整。双方的打击在同一回合生效，如果双方同时归零，则防守方守住阵地。把每回合的伤亡日志和仍然存活的人数都展示给我，最后给出结果、交战回合数和幸存者。防守方为 0 时直接判定为不战而胜的瞬间 'Victory'，在任何士气计算之前就结束——别让除法出错。另外再加一个 'rematch picker'，列出我编年史里的对手；选中一个就把防守方人数预填为我在那一战损失士兵数的两倍——就叫它我们侦察兵的驻军估计。
follow_ups.source_feature: Morale and Luck Combat Modifiers

ui_instruct.task: On the battle simulator, type 100 into the attacker field and 80 into the defender field, then type 2 into the luck field and add a 0 to make it 20.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The round-by-round log regenerates while typing with no submit action: with the counts in place, morale shows 80 and round one shows my side losing 22 to their bonus-boosted defense of 88; at luck 2 round one shows 21 defender casualties, which becomes 24 the moment the field reads 20.

ui_instruct.task: On the battle simulator, pick Ironhold Clan from the rematch picker, type 200 into the attacker field and 0 into the luck field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The defender field pre-fills with 80 (double the 40 soldiers lost to them, not 40 itself), morale shows 40, and round one of the log shows the outnumbered defenders trading up: 20 defender casualties (a quarter of 200 times morale 0.40) against 22 attacker casualties (a quarter of their bonus-boosted 88).

ui_instruct.task: On the battle simulator, type 150 into the attacker field and 0 into the defender field.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The projection shows an instant walkover Victory with no rounds fought — no crash, blank screen, error, or NaN from the zero-defender morale division.

ui_instruct.task: Open the rematch picker on the battle simulator and choose Silverpine Sentinels.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The picker lists exactly the six chronicle opponents, and choosing Silverpine Sentinels pre-fills the defender count with 42 (double the 21 soldiers lost to them).

ui_instruct.task: Open the reports page and look at the Duskwing Riders defeat entry.
ui_instruct.expected_result: No salvage option is offered on the Duskwing Riders entry (defeats leave no lootable field), while victory entries do show one.

follow_ups.instruction: 该玩点政治了。预置两个同盟——Crimson Pact，标签 CP，成员有 Lady Maren、Thorgrim 和 Vex；Iron Oath，标签 IO，成员有 Bramble、Karzok、Ossian、Petra 和 Ulf——并确保这八个对手都出现在 'ranking page' 上，名字旁边带着他们的同盟标签。我想从 'messages page' 发出 'join request'；这封信要稍微吹嘘一下，直接从编年史里取出我打赢的场数和掠夺 Gold 总量，同盟的接受回信会回到我的消息里，并标上它送达的游戏天数，然后我就进入他们的成员名单，成员人数也随之更新。一次只能加入一个同盟——如果我已经宣誓效忠一个同盟还去加入另一个，要警告我这意味着退出，并让我确认。对了，我的帝国叫 Ravenspire——凡是出现我名字的地方都用它。
follow_ups.source_feature: Tribe Diplomacy and Private Forums

ui_instruct.task: From the messages page, send a join request to the Iron Oath and open the letter that was sent.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The letter quotes 4 victories and 1,560 gold plundered from the chronicle — not 6 battles and not any other totals.

ui_instruct.task: From the messages page, send a join request to the Crimson Pact and wait for the reply.
ui_instruct.expected_result: An acceptance reply appears in the messages list, and the Crimson Pact roster now lists Ravenspire with the member count reading 4.

ui_instruct.task: Join the Crimson Pact, then send a join request to the Iron Oath and confirm the warning that appears.

target_app_summary: The text-based strategy game has grown from a resource-and-battle skeleton into a full empire sim. The bank became a live merchant exchange with cut-before-round conversion math; the reports page became a seeded war chronicle whose six pinned battles feed almost everything downstream: salvage expeditions harvest debris from its victories, a Hall of Plaques tiers its aggregates, a round-by-round battle simulator pre-fills rematches from its opponents, alliance join letters quote its record, and a power score counts its victories. On top sit alliance diplomacy with tagged rivals on the ranking, a Territories module whose outposts re-sort the ranking live with alphabetical tiebreaks, a royal war-room restyle unifying five pages, and a Herald's Proclamation composer that publishes a live-valued summary of the chronicle, plaques, power/rank and alliance state to the messages page. The feature graph is hub-shaped around the chronicle (T3) with two chains three deep (T1-T3-T5-T10 and T1-T3-T9-T10).

global_rules.rule: Any action that spends or converts resources shows the exact numbers involved and requires an explicit confirm before it applies, everywhere in the app.

follow_ups.instruction: 用'credit score inquiry'的人接下来问的总是同一件事——好吧，那到底能涨多少？给我做一个'Score Improvement Estimator'页面：他们输入'current score'（只接受 300 到 850）以及有多少'collections'、'late payments'和'hard inquiries'，'projected score'随着输入实时重新计算——我们每清除一条'collection' +25 分，每条'late payment' +15 分，每次查询 +5 分，但永远不超过 850——然后根据总提升推荐一个方案：低于 40 分是'Basic'，40 到 75 是'Standard'，超过 75 是'Premium'。把它接到你已经做好的'credit score inquiry'上：有人提交查询后，提供一个'project my improvement'按钮，打开估算器并带入他们的评分（如果查询里还没有'current score'字段，就加一个）。另外有两条从现在起适用于这个应用所有地方的规矩，包括我们以后新增的内容：任何地方显示的信用评分旁边都要带上等级——低于 580 'Poor'，580-669 'Fair'，670-739 'Good'，740-799 'Very Good'，800 及以上'Excellent'，例如 '612 (Fair)'——并且每个表单或工具都保留一个可见的'Start over'，把它清空回全新的空白状态。

target_app_summary: What began as an old-lace-and-rosy-brown lead-gen brochure site for a credit repair company has grown into a full client acquisition and service portal. Discovery and conversion now run through a live score-improvement estimator wired to the original credit score inquiry, a tie-aware filterable success-stories directory, and a checkout-style plan enrollment flow that inherits the estimator's plan recommendation. Service delivery grew its own arm rooted in the original lead form: the form's submitted name auto-signs the dispute letter builder's letters, saved letters feed a Draft/Sent/Resolved dispute tracker, and the tracker in turn drives both an impact dashboard and a per-creditor dispute strategy advisor that rolls cases up by creditor, ranks them by a priority score with a multi-bureau bonus, and derives each creditor's next move. A consultation scheduler with per-advisor slot availability and a site-wide brand restyle round it out. The feature graph has one deep service chain (lead form -> letter builder -> tracker -> dashboard/advisor), a conversion chain (inquiry -> estimator -> enrollment), and three silent app-wide conventions (score band labels, '+N pts' gain formatting, Start-over resets) tested across every new surface.

edges.what: inquiry's captured score prefills the estimator
lead form's submitted name auto-signs the generated dispute letters
saved letters become Draft dispute cases
aggregates the seven pinned success stories
items-resolved stat counts tracker's resolved cases live
restyles home page and lead form
restyles estimator page
restyles success stories page and plan badges
restyles letter builder page
restyles dispute tracker and status badges
restyles impact dashboard page
estimator's plan recommendation preselects the enrollment plan
advisor rolls live tracker cases into per-creditor next actions and priority rankings

global_rules.rule: Every displayed credit score carries its band label next to it — under 580 Poor, 580-669 Fair, 670-739 Good, 740-799 Very Good, 800+ Excellent — e.g. '612 (Fair)'.
Every form or tool surface keeps a visible 'Start over' control that resets it to its initial blank state.
Score gains always render with a leading plus sign and 'pts' suffix, e.g. '+84 pts'.

target_app_summary: The clinical office brochure site grows into a full patient-facing clinic hub. Discovery grows through a seeded seven-provider team directory with tie-aware experience ordering, a live header search over doctors, services and pages, and a Plan Your Visit page pairing the hours table with a weekly doctor-coverage grid (per-day totals and tie-aware fullest-day highlight); self-service grows through a live visit cost estimator and a validated appointment-request workflow (accepting-only providers, on-site-day and phone validation, self-pay pricing reuse, review step, My Requests statuses); operations grow through a front-desk Requests Board that tallies and resolves those requests, and a pinned/date-ordered notices center feeding the homepage. A site-wide brand restyle with homepage quick-link cards and an English/Espanol mode that reorders the directory for Spanish-speaking doctors round it out. The feature graph fans out from the provider directory (feeding estimator, planner, requests, search, board and language mode), with a three-deep chain from base nav through the directory and appointment workflow into the triage board.

instruction: 请创建一个用于宣传“Fundraiser Day”的单页网站，包含活动介绍、募款人感言、优惠信息和公司信息。网站应具备这些功能：自动轮播展示优惠的轮播图、展示募款人感言的板块，以及展示公司信息的板块。用户可以浏览网站，进一步了解Fundraiser Day这个活动。请以 'cornsilk'（玉米丝白）作为主背景色，控件使用 'peru'（秘鲁棕）。网站上所有可见的界面——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求中给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文，请完全按原样使用。

ui_instruct.expected_result: The testimonials section should display real and relevant feedback from previous fundraiser participants, demonstrating positive experiences and successful outcomes.

ui_instruct.expected_result: The section should provide complete and correct details about the company, including its mission, background, and role in organizing Fundraiser Day.

ui_instruct.expected_result: Users should be able to smoothly navigate between the introduction, testimonials, offers, and company information sections with no broken links or errors.

ui_instruct.task: Assess the website's content for relevance to the Fundraiser Day promotion.
ui_instruct.expected_result: All text and multimedia content should focus on promoting Fundraiser Day, eliminating any unrelated information that could detract from the event's promotion.

follow_ups.instruction: 活动现在真的收到捐款了，所以我想在页面上感言板块的正下方加一个“Supporter Wall”板块。先用这八笔捐赠开始，就是这些——以后我再添加：Maria Alvarez $250（River Runners 队，Clean Water）、James O'Neil $145（Bright Sparks 队，Education）、Maria Alvarez 再次捐出 $300（River Runners，Clean Water）、Priya Shah $500（Bright Sparks，Education）、Tom Becker $95（River Runners，Food Relief）、Lena Fischer $100（Green Hearts 队，Food Relief）、Sam Waters $40（Green Hearts，Clean Water）、Dana Cole $610（Green Hearts，Education）。每个人在墙上只出现一次，把他捐过的全部金额加总显示，并在他的条目上带一个标明等级的徽章——$500 及以上为Gold，$100 及以上为Silver，低于此为Bronze——并按照对应的Gold、Silver、Bronze致谢分区归类，每个分区内总额最高的排在最前，同时也显示他们的队伍和捐助的事业。有两件事我希望在整个应用里始终如此，现在和以后新增的部分都一样：美元金额一律带 $ 符号，千位用逗号分隔；每当我们给个人或队伍排名时，并列的按字母顺序排列。

target_app_summary: The one-page Fundraiser Day promo site grows into a full campaign platform for the event. A supporter wall with cumulative recognition tiers (seeded with eight pinned gifts) feeds a live pledge builder wired into the homepage offer tiers, and both feed a Campaign Pulse dashboard (total, goal progress, unique supporters, cause rollups, tie-aware team leaderboard). On top of the dashboard sit a Share Studio message composer that embeds live campaign stats and an Impact Report that floor-converts per-cause dollars into tangible units and reconciles with the dashboard. Around that core, the app grows sideways into a conflict-checking Day Schedule planner, a boolean-filtered Partner Coalition directory, and a validated Updates Hub subscription workflow, and a late visual refresh restyles the home page, wall, dashboard, and directory consistently. The graph has one deep money chain (wall -> pledges -> dashboard -> share/impact) plus three standalone modules and a four-surface restyle.

cause-tagged pledges move impact unit counts

restyles partner cards and directory controls

instruction: 请实现一个提供保洁服务的家庭保洁服务网站。网站应具备预订服务、服务咨询以及与我们取得联系的功能。用户应能够浏览网站、了解保洁服务的详情、预订保洁服务、查询service status，并通过电话号码和电子邮箱地址联系客服人员。请把背景设置为 'azure mist'（天蓝薄雾色），并把 'dark slate blue'（深板岩蓝）应用到各个组件上。网站上所有可见的界面——所有标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求中给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文的，必须原样照用。

target_app_summary: What started as a simple house-cleaning brochure site (booking, inquiry, status check, contact) has grown into a full service-business platform. Discovery and pricing grew an instant quote estimator over a fixed six-package catalog, a ZIP-based service-area checker that feeds travel fees into quotes, and a side-by-side package comparison table. Commerce grew a gift-certificate store with a balance ledger, a quote-to-checkout booking flow with certificate redemption math, and a membership plans configurator with recurring discounts. Social proof lives in a filterable reviews hub whose averages feed both the comparison table and an owner-facing Business Snapshot dashboard that rolls up booked revenue, outstanding certificate balances, and overall rating. A site-wide restyle (deep teal actions, bordered cards, uppercase headings, golden stars) unifies the grown surface area. The feature graph has one deep spine (estimator -> area fees -> checkout -> dashboard) plus reviews and certificates each feeding two downstream consumers.

target_app_summary: The All-In Bourbon Bar's brochure site has grown into a full club platform. Discovery grew a multi-criteria Bourbon Library screener that feeds an interactive Build-a-Flight tool and a rated Tasting Journal with a Top Shelf leaderboard. The poker side grew a tournament calendar with a real registration workflow, a one-click Guest Pass night board with claim caps and cancellations that reopen sold-out nights, all respecting tournament blackout nights, and a capstone Night Out Planner that assembles tournaments, saved flights, and plus-one passes into one costed, points-previewed itinerary. Commerce and loyalty grew a denomination-pick gift card studio with printed bonus tiers and a per-keystroke card preview and a Player's Ledger that rolls flights, registrations, and card purchases into a tiered points balance, and a site-wide 'card table' restyle unified the look. The graph's spine is T1->T2->T4->T7->T10, with the ledger (T7) fanning in from three earlier features and the planner (T10) fanning in from four.

follow_ups.instruction: 我们让报告真正具有预测性，做一个 'weighted pipeline forecast'。每个阶段都有一个成交概率，我可以在 'settings' 里编辑——初始值为 'New' 10、'Contacted' 25、'Qualified' 50、'Proposal' 75，只能是 0 到 100 的整数——预测把每条未关闭线索的 'deal value' 乘以它所在阶段的概率再汇总，只要我改动一个数字就立刻重新计算。把处于 'Lost' 的线索完全排除在外；如果以后有任何处于 'Won' 的线索，就在一个单独的成交收入数字里显示，而不是计入加权总额。在主要数字下面给我一份按线索的明细，显示每条线索的贡献，线索按惯例的写法书写；还有一条长期偏好：只要阶段以列表形式出现——这份明细、下拉菜单、以后的任何报告——都按 'New'、'Contacted'、'Qualified'、'Proposal'、'Won'、'Lost' 的顺序排列，绝不按字母顺序。
