target_app_summary: The base lead-management CRM grows into a full sales platform. Discovery and prioritization come from an engagement scoring engine with per-lead activity logs (pinned six-lead seed) and later an Inbox/Pipeline triage split fed by a lead-capture form builder. Outreach grows into a template studio with live placeholder previews, trigger-based automation rules that send templates and create dated tasks, and an outreach hub with simulated open-tracking that feeds back into scores. Analytics grow into a weighted pipeline forecast with editable stage probabilities and a build-your-own KPI dashboard that must mirror the forecast. A mid-ladder app-wide restyle sweeps all surfaces. The graph has a deep chain (templates -> automation -> outreach hub) plus reconciliation edges (dashboard mirrors forecast; inbox exclusion constrains forecast, dashboard, and rankings).

edges.what: base leads table and status editing that scores/activities attach to
message-sending flow the templates plug into
settings page hosting probabilities; lead stages and deal values
saved templates with placeholders that rules send
lead status changes that trigger rules
leads, reports, settings pages restyled
score temperature tags restyled as pills
template studio restyled
forecast breakdown table restyled
tasks page restyled
automation-sent messages populate the hub feed
opens add +3 to the engagement score and re-rank
average engagement score tile aggregates scores
forecast tile must mirror the forecast page total
test-submit creates a real lead in the CRM
web-form submissions land in the Inbox
promotion adds value x stage probability to the forecast
inbox leads excluded from score rankings
inbox leads excluded from dashboard tiles

global_rules.rule: Every engagement score, anywhere it appears in the app, carries a temperature tag: 0-2 Cold, 3-5 Warm, 6+ Hot.
Leads are always written as first and last name, a middle dot, then company (e.g. 'Rosa Delgado · Brightline Media') everywhere they are referenced.
Wherever stages appear as a list (dropdowns, breakdowns, reports), they follow pipeline order New, Contacted, Qualified, Proposal, Won, Lost — never alphabetical.

target_app_summary: The little technical-articles site grows into a full developer knowledge hub. Discovery gets deep: a multi-criteria article screener with saved presets and tie-aware sorting, plus a Trending This Week dashboard that scores articles from weekly views and emoji reactions. Community output becomes first-class: an emoji reaction system, a validated multi-step Share-a-Solution publishing flow, a contributor level system where reactions received and published solutions jointly gate Reader/Rising/Expert/Legend tiers (both conditions required, so the most-reacted author can still sit at Rising), and a curated Featured Queue that feeds the homepage. Personal tooling arrives with a bookmark-driven Reading List with rounded-up read times and progress tracking, and everything is capped by a Weekly Digest builder that auto-assembles trending, featured, and contributor-spotlight content behind per-section include/exclude toggles into a publishable digest with a live-rebuilding plain-text copy block. A mid-ladder site-wide restyle (dark slate header, teal actions, difficulty-colored card accents) must land consistently on every earlier surface. The feature graph runs deep: reactions feed trending, trending feeds the featured queue, and trending + featured + contributor levels all converge in the digest (T1->T3->T5->T8->T10).

target_app_summary: The anonymous campus forum grows into a full campus community platform. Discovery gets serious: an up/down voting system with net scores and tie-aware Top/New sorting feeds a windowed Trending tab, a multi-criteria screener with saved presets, and a publishable Campus Digest that snapshots trending posts and marketplace deals into frozen editions. Community tooling arrives via attachable opinion polls with live one-decimal percentage bars, per-thread emoji personas with an optional identity-reveal signature, and a report-driven Moderation Queue whose auto-flagging fires off vote-score thresholds. A three-step Marketplace adds practical campus utility with validated listings, category badges and price sorting. A final design pass unifies feed, Trending, Marketplace and Moderation Queue under one pill-badge, accent-stripe, signed-score visual language. The graph runs deep: voting (T2) powers Trending (T4), the screener (T6) and moderation auto-flagging (T7), while the Digest (T9) aggregates Trending and Marketplace output — a 3-deep chain T1-T2-T4-T9.

global_rules.rule: Net vote scores are always displayed with an explicit + sign when positive (e.g. +22), a plain 0 at zero, and a minus when negative — on every surface, including features added later.
Every topic or category label anywhere in the app is rendered lowercase with a leading # (e.g. #housing, #electronics) — app-wide, now and for anything added later.
Every count in the app is correctly pluralized ('1 vote' / '2 votes', '1 match', '1 report') — never '1 votes' — everywhere, forever.

target_app_summary: The base beige-and-saddle-brown Q&A site grows into a full community knowledge platform. A pinned seven-question seed powers a tag screener with boolean tag/status filtering and tie-aware score sorting; an ask composer adds live duplicate detection and strict validation; an accept-answer workflow introduces a Solved state that propagates into the screener, a Topics analytics hub, and a capstone Triage dashboard. A points-based bounty system feeds a Featured strip, the follow-and-digest builder, and the Triage urgency ranking, while an edit-suggestion review queue adds moderation whose pending count also lands on Triage. A site-wide restyle pass locks visual consistency across the screener, Topics, Review, and Digest pages. The graph runs several chains three-plus deep (base list -> screener -> bounties -> triage; base answers -> accept workflow -> topics/triage), so early breakage compounds.

Solved badge restyled to dark green pill

global_rules.rule: Scores always display with an explicit sign everywhere in the app: +8, -2, and a bare 0 only for zero.
Tags always render as lowercase pills prefixed with # everywhere they appear.
Any question with zero answers shows a small amber 'Needs answer' badge wherever it is listed, on all current and future surfaces.

instruction: 请实现一个加密货币托管（escrow）系统，用于安全的加密货币交易。买家应该可以浏览和选择卖家的加密货币商品、进行交易，并把加密货币存入托管账户。卖家应该可以查看和管理自己的商品以及交易记录。系统还应具备交易确认、加密货币放行和争议解决功能。请将背景色初始化为浅灰色（'light gray'），把组件颜色初始化为深红色（'dark red'）。另外，网站上所有可见的界面——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文。我在这些需求里给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文的，请完全按照原样使用。

ui_instruct.task: Browse the list of available cryptocurrency products.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The buyer can view a list of products with clear details like name, price, and seller information.

ui_instruct.task: Initiate a transaction by selecting a cryptocurrency product and attempting to deposit the equivalent amount into the escrow account.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The system successfully processes the deposit into the escrow account.

ui_instruct.task: Add a new cryptocurrency product.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The product is successfully added and immediately appears in the seller's product list.

ui_instruct.task: Submit a dispute for a transaction.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The dispute is lodged successfully, and the status of the transaction is updated to 'disputed'.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'light gray' as the background color and 'dark red' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'light gray' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark red', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: 大家在真正下单之前总是问我到底要花多少钱，所以给我们做一个'Fee Calculator'页面。我输入一个 USD 金额并选择一种币种——BTC、ETH 或 SOL，固定参考价分别为 $60,000, $2,500 和 $140——我一边输入，整个明细就实时更新：我们 1.5% 的平台费由买卖双方平摊，买家还要付一笔固定的网络费（BTC $2.50、ETH $1.20、SOL $0.10），买家总共要付多少，卖家实际到手多少，以及这笔美元金额按参考价能买到多少加密货币。低于 $100 或高于 $250,000 的金额就只显示一句友好的提示，而不是数字——请不要出现 NaN 之类的怪东西。还有一条适用于本应用各处的统一格式规范，现在以及以后新增的部分都要遵守：加密货币数量一律保留正好 8 位小数，并把代号写在数字后面，例如 0.16666667 BTC；美元金额一律写成 $1,234.56 的形式。

ui_instruct.expected_result: At 50 a friendly note appears instead of any figures (no NaN or broken numbers anywhere); at 100 the full breakdown appears with real dollar values.

ui_instruct.task: Open the Fee Calculator page and look at its overall styling.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The page keeps the app's light gray background and its primary components (such as buttons or the header) are styled dark red, consistent with the rest of the app.

follow_ups.instruction: 交易记录太分散了——给我做一个像样的、面向整个平台的'Trade Ledger'页面。页面上正好加载这八笔交易，别的都不要，以后我自己再往里加：TX-101 Dana 以 $30,000.00 从 Marcus 买入 0.50000000 BTC（'Released'）；TX-102 Felix 以 $25,000.00 从 Lena 买入 10.00000000 ETH（'Released'）；TX-103 Dana 以 $70,000.00 从 Omar 买入 500.00000000 SOL（'Refunded'）；TX-104 Ravi 以 $12,000.00 从 Marcus 买入 0.20000000 BTC（'Disputed'）；TX-105 Felix 以 $12,500.00 从 Lena 买入 5.00000000 ETH（'Released'）；TX-106 Ana 以 $21,000.00 从 Omar 买入 150.00000000 SOL（'Released'）；TX-107 Ravi 以 $37,500.00 从 Priya 买入 15.00000000 ETH（'In Escrow'）；TX-108 Ana 以 $6,000.00 从 Marcus 买入 0.10000000 BTC（'Released'）。页面顶部给我几张汇总卡片：一张显示'total released volume'——只有状态为'Released'的交易才计入这个数字——另一张显示当前的'locked in escrow'，也就是现在有多少钱锁在托管里，记住'Disputed'的资金仍然躺在托管账户里，所以它们同样算作被锁定。下面是'per-seller breakdown'，显示每个卖家'Released'的金额；并且任何人通过购买流程新产生的交易都要自动出现在账本里。从现在起的统一风格：本应用中的每个状态，无论是在这个页面还是以后新建的页面，都用一个小药丸徽章表示——'In Escrow'用琥珀色（'amber'），'Released'用绿色（'green'），'Refunded'用灰色（'gray'），'Disputed'用深红色（'dark red'）。

follow_ups.instruction: 卖家老是催我什么时候能真正拿到钱，所以做一个'Payout Center'。它有一个卖家选择器：我选中某个卖家，就能看到他的'lifetime earned'——账本里他每一笔状态为'Released'的交易，按毛额减去我们按费用表收取的 0.75% 卖家侧费用；'Refunded'、'Disputed'和'In Escrow'的交易一律不计入——再加上待支付或已支付的金额，以及当前的'available balance'。卖家可以在这里输入金额申请提现：超过'available balance'的金额要拒绝，最低金额是 $250, 低于这个数的申请同样要拒绝；申请一旦通过，就要立刻把这笔钱冻结，让可用的金额马上减少。申请会进入管理员审批页面上的待处理队列，我在那里逐条批准或拒绝——批准后移入已支付历史列表，拒绝则解除冻结并把钱退回可用的余额中。另外，从现在开始有一条规矩：本应用中任何地方只要涉及转移或放行资金的操作，都必须先向我显示一个带有确切美元金额的确认提示才能执行——以后新增的功能也一样。

follow_ups.instruction: 买家总问跟谁交易才安全，所以我们把卖家信誉做扎实，直接根据'Trade Ledger'计算：每个卖家每有一笔'Released'的交易就加 1 分，每有一笔'Refunded'的交易就减 1 分——退款就是平台记下的一个污点——而'In Escrow'和'Disputed'的交易在最终结清之前都不计分。做一个'Leaderboard'页面，按分数给所有卖家排名——分数相同时，'Released'美元金额更高的卖家排在前面——每一行显示分数、'Released'交易的笔数和'Released'金额，并且在卖家的商品出现的任何地方都在他名字旁边标上分数。只要任何一笔交易的状态发生变化——放行、退款，什么都算——排名都要自动重新排列。

target_app_summary: The base crypto escrow marketplace has grown into a full P2P trading platform. It gained a live fee-and-payout calculator, a platform-wide Trade Ledger with released/locked rollups seeded with eight pinned trades, a seller Payout Center with fee-netted lifetime earnings and a hold-then-approve withdrawal queue, a seller reputation leaderboard with refund penalties and volume tiebreaks, a sandboxed practice mode with a mock wallet and its own seeded practice listings, a multi-criteria offer screener with saved presets and a reputation filter, a per-keystroke counter-offer negotiation console that re-prices screener offers, a brand restyle across five pages, and copyable seller statements that reconcile ledger records against the fee schedule and the Payout Center. The ledger (T3) is the hub: payout balances and reputation scores are computed from it, practice mode must leave it untouched, and statements are generated from it; the fee schedule (T2) feeds the Payout Center, the negotiation console, and the statements; reputation chains into the screener and the screener into the negotiation console, giving deep chains like T1->T3->T5->T7->T8 and T1->T3->T4->T10.

global_rules.rule: Crypto amounts are always shown to exactly 8 decimal places with the ticker after the number (e.g. 0.16666667 BTC), and dollar figures always as $1,234.56 with commas and two decimals.
Every trade status is a color-coded pill badge everywhere: amber In Escrow, green Released, gray Refunded, dark red Disputed.
Any action that moves or releases funds shows a confirmation with the exact dollar amounts before it completes.

target_app_summary: What began as a simple linen-and-maroon apartment rental site has grown into a full short-stay platform. Discovery grew a chip-scored fit ranker over a pinned seven-apartment catalog, a heart-saved shortlist with date-priced comparison, and a flexible-stay finder that searches for open stretches of nights; money runs through a live trip cost estimator whose fee math feeds both the shortlist compare and a multi-stop trip planner with an on-screen copyable itinerary. Operations gained an Instant Book vs request-approval pipeline with a host inbox, whose confirmed stays drive per-listing availability calendars, neighborhood insight rollups, and the finder's gap search. A warm restyle unified pill buttons, serif headings, and outlined status pills across every surface. The feature graph runs deep: base booking flow into the request pipeline into availability calendars into the trip planner and stay finder, alongside fit ranker into shortlist into planner.

target_app_summary: The consulting site grows from a brochure-with-cart into a full training platform. Discovery gets a multi-criteria program finder over a pinned catalog of eight programs (wired into the existing cart) and a live-scoring role/topic matcher. Commerce and planning gain a team-quote estimator with tiered volume discounts and a learning-path builder whose saved paths feed a progress-and-certificates layer. Community arrives via a live Q&A session registration flow with capacity and waitlists, and everything rolls up into a My Learning dashboard that reconciles path hours, completed hours, registrations, and certificates. A site-wide design refresh and a fixed-rate multi-currency layer cut across the finder, estimator, paths, and the original services pages. The graph's spine is finder -> path builder -> progress -> dashboard, with the estimator, sessions, matcher, restyle, and currency features hanging off it.

target_app_summary: The little lemon-chiffon bidding site has grown into a full auction-trading platform. Discovery got serious: a multi-criteria screener with saved presets over a pinned seven-lot catalog, a starred watchlist with live value rollups, a Market Movers panel with tie-aware rankings, and a July 2026 close-date calendar that cross-filters by category and watchlist. Trading mechanics deepened: a live bid ticket computes tiered increments and fee-inclusive totals per keystroke, and a close-and-settle workflow turns Closing lots into searchable Completed Sales records using the same fee schedule. Community and context layers sit on top — seller profiles with half-up-rounded ratings and a tie-broken leaderboard gated on settled sales, and per-listing price-history charts with windowed high/low stats — before a final chocolate-pill restyle sweeps every surface. The feature graph runs one deep chain (bid ticket -> settlement -> reputation) alongside a discovery cluster (screener -> watchlist -> calendar) and movers fed by ticket activity.

adds detail chart onto base catalog listings
reviews gated on Completed Sales records from settlement
watched-only calendar filter driven by watchlist stars
restyles base browse and history pages
restyles screener buttons and prices
restyles watchlist cards
restyles Completed Sales page
restyles movers panel cards
restyles seller profiles
restyles calendar entries and pills

global_rules.rule: Session change percentages always display signed with exactly two decimals (e.g. +5.25%, -1.10%) on every surface.
Listing status always renders as a colored pill badge — green Open, amber Closing, gray Settled — wherever a listing appears.
Any money-committing or irreversible action (bids, settlements) always shows a confirmation summary before executing.

target_app_summary: The base email composer has grown into a full email-operations suite. Around the original compose/send/templates core, it gained a seeded Delivery Log with status badges and combined status+search filtering, a Blocklist that live-validates and gates every send, an Analytics page computing open/bounce rates and a tie-broken opens leaderboard from the log, a Scheduled-send Outbox with a pinned platform clock that dispatches into the log, a per-keystroke personalization preview that pulls sample recipients from the log, an A/B subject-test wizard whose audience is the deduped log minus the blocklist, a segment builder computing saved audiences from log engagement minus the blocklist that feeds compose, a full design restyle across all surfaces, and a live copyable account Digest that reconciles the log, analytics, blocklist, outbox, and segments. The feature graph funnels through the Delivery Log (five consumers) and the Blocklist (three consumers), with the deepest chain running compose -> log -> analytics -> digest.

target_app_summary: The base traceability site (register products, track circulation, inquire status, verify authenticity, view stats) grows into a full supply-chain integrity platform. Operations gains lot-level grouping with rolled-up lot statuses, a validating bulk event importer that feeds product journeys, and a lot-scoped recall workflow with retrieval progress and auto-close. Anti-counterfeit tooling adds a scan monitor that logs every verification check and flags 7-day scan bursts against a typed threshold, plus a counterfeit report intake and investigation queue that uses the scan log as evidence and can flip products (and their lots) to Flagged. Discovery and quality surfaces add a multi-criteria registry screener with any-of status logic, presets and an on-page text export, a chain integrity audit that sweeps every journey for custody gaps (skipped shipping legs, activity after delivery) and ranks lots by issue count with clean badges, and a checkpoint analytics page that dedups products per location and ranks with alphabetical tie-breaks. A mid-ladder restyle unifies five surfaces under one firebrick-on-misty-rose skin. The graph runs deep: lots feed recalls and every lot-grouped rollup, and the importer feeds lot rollups, the integrity audit, and checkpoint analytics.

target_app_summary: The base e-government portal grows into a full municipal resource-planning suite centered on a live budget-lines ledger. Procurement gains a keystroke-live requisition builder with budget validation and approval tiers, plus a supplier-facing vendor portal with quote tie-breaking and awards. Finance gains a travel-and-expense approval workflow that posts approved spending onto the ledger, a grants module with over-spend guards, and a what-if scenario planner that clones live spending. Decision-making gains a utilization/variance report with tie-aware ranking and rounding-sensitive rollups, a KPI dashboard whose statuses are computed against budget-line utilization, and a council decision-packet workflow that compiles the report, the KPI tallies, and council-tier procurement items into a reviewable, approvable brief. The feature graph runs a deep spine (budget lines -> expense posting -> utilization report -> decision packets) with the planner, KPI dashboard, and vendor portal branching off the same spine, and a mid-ladder restyle sweeping every surface.

target_app_summary: The base time-attendance app grows into a full workforce operations suite for a small company. A pinned six-person roster with an exact seeded week of hours (Mar 2-7, 2026) feeds a ranked weekly rollup, an overtime/exceptions board, a live pay-stub calculator, a filterable payroll report with on-screen export, and a schedule-adherence scoreboard. Around that analytics core sit workflows and tools: a PIN kiosk that punches straight into timesheets, a PTO/leave center with request-approve-deduct mechanics, and a punch-correction queue whose approvals rewrite timesheet days and cascade through the rollup and overtime flags. The graph runs deep: roster/timesheets (T2) feed overtime (T4) which feeds payroll (T6) and correction propagation (T8), while leave (T5) feeds both the report export (T7) and adherence scoring (T9); a final restyle (T10) sweeps six surfaces. App-wide conventions - 'Xh Ym' durations, 'Mon, Mar 2' dates, and confirm-before-approve/reject - are introduced early and silently enforced on every later surface.

edges.what: rolls up the base app's attendance records
kiosk punches toggle the base clock-in/out status
PINs resolve against the seeded roster; punches land in timesheets
overtime computed over the seeded week's timesheets
PTO balances start from the roster's seeded allowances
wages and weekly hours from roster/timesheets
regular/overtime hour split from the overtime classification
report rows built from timesheet weekly hours
approved (never pending) leave lines in the export
approved corrections rewrite timesheet days and re-rank the rollup
approved corrections re-trigger overtime flags
adherence compares schedule against timesheet punches
approved leave counts as covered days in the score
restyles the base dashboard
restyles the weekly rollup
restyles the kiosk
restyles the overtime board
restyles the leave center
restyles the pay calculator

global_rules.rule: Durations are always displayed as hours and minutes like '7h 30m' - never decimal hours - everywhere in the app, now and for anything added later.
Dates are always written weekday-first like 'Mon, Mar 2' everywhere in the app from turn 4 onward.
Any approve or reject action anywhere in the app asks for confirmation before it goes through.

target_app_summary: The single-form women's health survey site grows into a small research-program platform. Discovery and intake expand into a sectioned survey wizard with conditional questions and a demo fill, plus a standalone wellness self-check calculator that nudges high-stress and low-sleep users toward taking the full survey. On the analysis side, a cohort screener with AND/OR demographic filtering becomes the hub: an insights strip cross-filters live stats over it, an export composer renders copyable extracts of the filtered set, and a flag-based follow-up queue with Pending/Contacted/Resolved adjudication feeds a Program Outcomes report that rolls up a resolution rate and a reached-stage outcome funnel, with suggested flags scanned from the cohort. A question bank with per-question versioning governs the wizard's wording, and a site-wide restyle unifies buttons, headings, cards, ID chips and tables across all surfaces. The graph hangs off the screener (T2) with a deep chain T1 -> T2 -> T6 -> T10 (T2 also feeding T10's suggested flags), wizard chains T2 -> T4 -> T9, and a calculator nudge T1 -> T3.

target_app_summary: The driver recruitment site grows from a simple job board with registration and a contact form into a full two-sided hiring platform. Drivers get a multi-criteria job screener over a pinned board of carrier listings, a live pay calculator that saves a personal pay target, a match-score tuner that ranks every job against their preferences, and a My Applications tracker that mirrors applied state onto the job board with Applied markers and handles confirm-gated withdrawals. Clients get an applications dashboard with per-posting rollups, a status pipeline, company profile pages with rating-ranked directory and pay averages, and an interview scheduling flow with slot-conflict handling that writes back to the driver's side. A late full-site restyle unifies buttons, headings, cards, and badges across every surface. The feature graph has two deep spines: jobs-page features stack screener -> featured ranking -> company listings, and the hiring pipeline stacks the base apply flow -> application tracker -> client dashboard -> interview scheduling (4 deep), with the calculator's saved target feeding the match tuner.

target_app_summary: The one-to-one coaching matcher has grown into a full coaching marketplace and management suite. Discovery grew a real screener over a pinned seven-coach directory (specialty OR-checkboxes ANDed with typed price/experience caps) and a per-keystroke booking cost estimator with tiered discounts, while scheduling grew a per-keystroke block planner that lays out a whole run of proposed session dates (weekly or every-two-weeks), does honest month-boundary date math, and flags clashes against the live booking calendar. Relationship workflows grew a free intro-call request pipeline (user request -> coach inbox -> accept/decline with confirmations), post-session star ratings that feed averages, sorting and a minimum-rating filter back into the screener, and a per-coach engagement journal with an on-screen plain-text export. Planning grew milestone-based goal tracking with a milestone-weighted overall rollup, and everything converges on a coaching hub whose tiles (upcoming sessions, pending intro requests, unrated sessions) stay in lockstep with the underlying pages. A final visual system pass unifies buttons, cards, rating colors, and status chips across all surfaces. The graph runs two deep chains — directory -> trial requests -> hub, and directory -> ratings -> journal — so early breakage compounds.

global_rules.rule: Any coach rate shown anywhere is spelled out like '$120 per session', never a bare number.
Every percentage anywhere in the app (discounts, goal progress, anything else) is a whole number with a % sign, no decimals.
Any cancel, decline, or delete action anywhere asks for confirmation before it goes through.

target_app_summary: The little sorting game has grown into a full kids' eco-arcade. Identity and progression came first: an Avatar Studio with validated nicknames, then a My Journey stats page that logs every finished round (seeded with six exact rounds) and computes weighted accuracy, recent-form vs all-time averages, and a tie-broken best-round spotlight. On top of the journey grew a Recycle City map whose four themed spots unlock from history scores, an Impact Calculator with a lifetime counter, a star-currency Sticker Shop, a teacher-facing Challenge Builder that draws item piles from the map and pre-fills targets from the journey, and a dedup-collectible Fact Card Album banked by spot visits. A Deep Sea Rescue restyle swept the game, map, journey and shop, and everything converges in an Eco Hero Certificate maker that renders the buddy, stars, best round, sticker count and fact completion in a live preview plus copyable text block. The graph is journey-centric: T3 feeds T4, T5, T6, T8, T9 and T10, with a four-deep chain T1-T3-T4-T9-T10.

target_app_summary: The base obituary portal has grown into a full family memorial platform. Discovery grew via a tag-and-decade browse archive with sorts, an 'On This Date' anniversary lookup, and a keystroke-live headstone inscription designer that engraves epitaphs onto obituary pages. Community grew via a moderated memory-submission workflow, threaded condolence guestbooks whose reply counts feed the archive's busiest-guestbook sort, per-memorial fundraising drives that the archive can filter on, and RSVP headcounts for funeral services. Planning grew via an assigned family task checklist with progress rollups, and the whole app was restyled from peru to forest green. The feature graph has a deep chain (base -> browse archive -> funds/guestbook threading -> restyle) plus several dashboard-anchored workflows, all computing over one pinned set of six memorials.

global_rules.rule: All dates anywhere in the app are written with the month spelled out, like 'March 12, 1932' — never numeric forms like 03/12/32.
Every deceased person's name, wherever it appears, is followed by their lifespan years in parentheses, e.g. 'Harold Finch (1932–2024)'.
Any action that declines, removes, or deletes content asks for confirmation ('are you sure') first, app-wide.

follow_ups.instruction: 我们来加一个那种'What's your wellness focus?'的测验——五道题，每道题四个答案选项，每个选项都清楚标注它偏向的主题（Nutrition、Fitness、Sleep或Mind），选完一个答案就直接跳到下一题。答题过程中我想看到自己的进度：当前是第几题，以及我各主题选择的实时计数，还要有一个返回按钮，让我修改之前的答案时重新计数而不是重复累加。最后我的wellness focus就是我选得最多的那个主题——如果两个主题打平，就选我最近选的那个。然后结果卡片要从archive中推荐该主题的文章，浏览量最高的排在前面。
follow_ups.source_feature: Interactive lifestyle quizzes

ui_instruct.task: Take the quiz, picking the Nutrition-tagged option on questions 1 and 3, the Fitness-tagged option on questions 2 and 4, and the Sleep-tagged option on question 5.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The results card names Fitness as the wellness focus — the two-two tie with Nutrition breaks toward Fitness because it was picked more recently.

ui_instruct.task: Start the quiz and answer question 1 with a Fitness-tagged option, then pause.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The running tally shows Fitness at 1 with the other topics at 0, and the progress indicator shows you are now on question 2 of 5 — all before the quiz is finished.

ui_instruct.task: Answer question 1 with a Fitness-tagged option, click the back control, and change your answer to a Sleep-tagged option.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The tally now shows Sleep at 1 and Fitness back at 0 — the old pick is removed, not double-counted.

ui_instruct.task: Finish the quiz picking a Fitness-tagged option every time, then look at the recommended articles on the results card.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The recommendations are Fitness articles listed most-viewed first — Strength Training After 50 on top — and each one shows an 'X min read' label plus its Medically Reviewed or Editorial tag.

ui_instruct.task: On the archive page, type 5 into the maximum read time box.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Only the three articles of 5 minutes or less remain visible — Hydration Myths Debunked at exactly '5 min read', 10-Minute Morning Stretch Routine, and The Science of Cold Showers.

follow_ups.instruction: 该做社区了：给我们的四个主题各自一个discussion board，并在该主题的分类页面上直接放一个通往对应discussion board的链接。Nutrition里预置'Best protein sources for vegetarians?'（2025 年 5 月 2 日，4 条回复）和'Is intermittent fasting safe?'（2025 年 4 月 11 日，同样 4 条回复），Fitness里预置'Knee pain after running'（2025 年 3 月 22 日，1 条回复），Sleep里预置'Can't fall asleep before 2am'（2025 年 5 月 9 日，暂无回复），Mind的discussion board暂时留空。任何人都可以用标题和正文发起一个帖子，点开一个帖子进行回复，community landing page要汇总每个discussion board的帖子总数和回复总数；在discussion board内部，每个帖子都列出它的回复数，最热闹的帖子排在前面（回复最多，打平时较新的胜出）。另外——这一条适用于这个应用里任何地方的任何列表，现在以及我们以后新增的部分——如果列表里没有内容，就显示一句友好的提示鼓励大家开个头，而不是一片空白。

follow_ups.instruction: 读者总是把健康问题丢在文章评论里，结果就淹没了——我们改成把他们引导到社区。加一个'Ask the Community'助手：一个输入框，有人在里面输入问题，在他们输入的同时——每敲一个键，不需要提交按钮——就判断这个问题属于我们四个discussion board中的哪一个。给每个主题一个小小的关键词列表（protein、meal、snack 对应 Nutrition；workout、knee、muscle 对应 Fitness；sleep、insomnia、nap 对应 Sleep；stress、anxiety、focus 对应 Mind——大小写不应有影响），统计问题中出现了该主题的几个词，然后路由到命中最多的主题；两个主题打平时，关键词在问题中出现更早的那个胜出。显示获胜的discussion board以及决定胜负的那些关键词，并在下面列出该discussion board已有的帖子，让大家看看是不是已经有人问过了，再加一个发布按钮，点击后跳到那个discussion board，并且新帖子已经用他们的问题作为标题，随时可以提交。

follow_ups.instruction: 我们的公信力计划：建一个Review Desk，把所有仍标着'Editorial'的文章放进一个等待医学复核的队列。打开队列中的文章会显示正文，加上一个两项的检查清单——来源已核实、论述准确——以及一个选择审核人的地方（Dr. Lena Ortiz 或 Dr. Sam Wexler）；在两项都勾选并选定审核人之前，批准一直不可用；另外还要有一个'要求修改'的选项，可以附一条说明，它让文章保持Editorial状态但在队列里被标记出来。一旦某篇被批准，它就应当离开队列，并在所有地方翻转为Medically Reviewed并带上医生姓名——它的文章页、archive、reviewed-only筛选器，全部都要。请把'Managing Stress at Work'设置成两项都已勾选并且已选定 Dr. Sam Wexler，这样我可以演示一键批准。

follow_ups.instruction: 最后一个大的：一个真正属于我的My Feed页面。它把两个来源——我关注的主题，以及我最近一次测验得出的关注点——合并成一个文章列表，但要保持精简：每个来源主题只有浏览量最高的两篇文章入选（浏览量打平时较新的胜出），入选的文章再合并成一个列表，按浏览量从高到低排序，用同样的规则打破平局。当一个主题同时来自两个来源时，它的文章仍然只出现一次，并标注来源（'Following'、'Quiz pick'，或者两者都有）。让我可以直接在这个页面上开关我关注的主题，并且一开始就已经关注Nutrition和Sleep。

target_app_summary: The little health blog has grown into a full wellness publishing platform. Discovery grew two ways: a filterable, paginated article archive with review-status and read-time screening, and a personalized My Feed that reconciles followed topics with quiz results into a top-two-per-topic list with provenance tags. Engagement grew into per-topic community boards with a reply workflow, a live question router that classifies a typed question onto the right board keystroke-by-keystroke and posts it as a pre-titled thread, and an engagement analytics dashboard that scores articles by views-per-minute and rolls up board activity. An editorial pipeline (Review Desk) gates which articles earn the Medically Reviewed badge, which in turn gates what the weekly digest composer may include — a three-deep chain from the seeded archive through review to the digest. A site-wide visual refresh (teal actions, badge pills, centered headings) ties the surfaces together, and app-wide conventions (min-read formatting, Reviewed/Editorial labels, friendly empty states) are enforced silently on every new surface.

edges.what: base blog articles and article pages the archive lists and links to
archive articles ranked by view counts for result-card recommendations
topic categories and category pages that host board links
routed questions land on the seeded boards; the winning board's threads are listed for duplicate checks and the pre-titled question posts there as a new thread
badge flip rendered on base article pages
approval moves articles into the archive's reviewed-only filter
Review Desk approval gates digest eligibility
read-time metadata summed into the live digest total
views and read times feed the views-per-minute score
board thread/reply activity aggregated per topic
restyles homepage and article pages
restyles archive cards and badge pills
restyles community landing and boards
restyles quiz flow and results card
restyles the digest subscribe button as a teal primary action
followed topics drive the feed's contents
latest quiz focus adds its topic's articles to the feed
feed items ranked by archive view counts with badge/read-time labels

global_rules.rule: Every article, anywhere it appears (lists, search results, quiz recommendations, digest, feed), carries either a 'Medically Reviewed' tag (with the doctor's name where there's room) or an 'Editorial' tag.
Read times are always written as 'X min read' everywhere in the app.
Any empty list or section anywhere shows a friendly nothing-here message with a nudge to act, never a blank area.

instruction: 请实现一个诗歌博客网站，用于展示和分享诗歌内容。网站应当具备浏览诗歌、搜索诗歌、发布诗歌和评论诗歌的功能。用户应当能够浏览不同类型的诗歌、搜索特定的诗歌、发布自己的诗歌，并对他人的诗歌发表评论。页面布局采用 light goldenrod（淡金菊黄），按钮和卡片使用 olive drab（橄榄褐绿）。网站上所有可见的界面——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和内容——都必须使用英文，而我在这些需求里给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文，必须原样照用。

ui_instruct.task: Verify the poetry browsing functionality.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user can access a list of poetry, with each entry displaying the title and author clearly.

ui_instruct.task: Test the search function by searching for a specific poem title.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The search returns results that include the poem with the matching title and no unrelated results.

ui_instruct.task: Test the process of posting new poetry.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user can fill out a form to input poetry title, content, and tags, then submit it successfully; the new poem should appear on the website.

ui_instruct.task: Test the functionality for posting a comment on an existing poem.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The user can submit a comment, and it appears under the poem along with the user's name and timestamp.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that users can navigate to different types of poetry categories.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Clicking on a category correctly filters and displays poems belonging to that category only.

ui_instruct.task: Verify that the website uses 'light goldenrod' as the background color and 'olive drab' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
ui_instruct.expected_result: The website has a background color of 'light goldenrod' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'olive drab', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

follow_ups.instruction: 读者一直跟我说，他们想为一首诗喝彩又不想写评论，所以我们加上闪耀：在每一首诗出现的地方都放一个 'sparkle button'，带一个累计计数，每位读者对每首诗最多只能给 3 次闪耀——给到第三次之后，按钮要清楚地表明已经给满了，而且误点之后要有办法把闪耀收回来。把里面现有的演示诗歌全部清掉，先用下面这七首开始，以后我再加：Cinders，作者 Mara Voss（'Haiku'，3 行，12 次闪耀，1 条评论）；Harbor Glass，作者 Theo Rin（'Sonnet'，14 行，9 次闪耀，4 条评论）；Wren Song，作者 Mara Voss（'Free Verse'，21 行，7 次闪耀，5 条评论）；Salt Meadow，作者 Ivy Chen（'Haiku'，3 行，12 次闪耀，0 条评论）；The Unsent Letter，作者 Theo Rin（'Free Verse'，30 行，6 次闪耀，2 条评论）；Juniper，作者 Ivy Chen（'Limerick'，5 行，8 次闪耀，3 条评论）；以及 Night Ferry，作者 Priya Anand（'Sonnet'，14 行，15 次闪耀，0 条评论）。诗歌正文和评论内容你自己编，但这些数字要保持完全一致，并在每首诗的详情里显示它的行数。有一条全站通用的样式规范，现在以及以后我们添加的任何东西都要遵守：一首诗的体裁（Haiku、Sonnet、Limerick、Free Verse）以一个小药丸徽章的形式显示在标题旁边，只要这首诗出现的地方都要有。

follow_ups.instruction: 网站需要一个 'Form Lab'——单独一个页面——在那里要对一首诗的结构做检查，而不只是欣赏。我选择一个目标体裁（'Haiku'、'Sonnet'、'Limerick'、'Free Verse'），在每个选项旁边显示网站上已发布的该体裁诗歌有多少首；然后当我在检查器里输入或粘贴草稿时，实时的行数统计和字数统计随着每一次按键更新——空行只是诗节之间的分隔，不能算作行。'Haiku' 正好是 3 行，'Limerick' 5 行，'Sonnet' 14 行，'Free Verse' 至少 1 行即可，而在行数与所选体裁相符之前，'Certify' 按钮一直保持关闭。我还应当能把任何已发布的诗歌载入检查器，对某首诗执行 'Certify' 之后，会在这首诗出现的所有地方，在它的药丸徽章旁边盖上一个 'form-true' 标记。

target_app_summary: The poetry blog has grown into a full community poetry platform. Readers cheer poems with capped, retractable sparkles; a homepage This Week's Board ranks poems by a buzz score of sparkles plus weighted comments; and a Form Lab checks haiku/limerick/sonnet line counts live per keystroke and certifies poems as form-true. On top of these grew a haiku contest with sparkle-driven voting and a crowned winner, a deduplicated Poets roster ranked by rolled-up sparkle totals, a structured Critique Corner peer-feedback workflow, a chapbook anthology builder with computed line totals, rounded read times, and a grouped table-of-contents export, and a Season Laurels ceremony that reconciles the board, contest, sparkles, and critiques into published awards. A mid-ladder restyle (plum buttons, centered serif headings, cream cards, amber sparkle counts, outlined form badges) sweeps four pages. The graph runs deep: sparkles feed the board, roster, contest, and laurels; the Form Lab's line check gates fresh contest entries; and the board's top three feed the anthology importer — so early breakage compounds through the late turns.

instruction: 请实现一个用于展示和管理链接的链接树网站。网站需要具备添加、编辑和删除链接的功能。用户应该能够创建和管理自己的链接树，包括添加新链接、编辑已有链接、删除不需要的链接，以及通过链接树的分享链接把自己的链接树分享给别人。把整体背景设为 papaya whip（木瓜奶白色），然后用 dark orange（深橙色）来设计各个组件的样式。网站上所有可见的界面文字——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和页面文案——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求里给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文的，请完全按原样使用。

ui_instruct.expected_result: A validation error message is displayed, preventing the user from adding the link until all required fields are completed.

ui_instruct.task: Test website navigation by navigating between the home page, link tree dashboard, and user profile.
ui_instruct.expected_result: Each navigation click takes the user to the correct page, without any errors.

target_app_summary: The one-page link tree has grown into a full creator link-in-bio platform. A click analytics dashboard (seeded with seven exact links and counts) feeds nearly everything: a public visitor Preview whose button clicks increment the counts, schedule windows with a typed viewing-as-of date simulator, group sections with click rollups, pin/move ordering that the Preview mirrors, a click-goals tracker whose bars move when visitors click, and a copyable weekly Digest that composes totals, top link, goal progress, and upcoming scheduled links. A teal-on-white rebrand restyles the manager, Analytics, and Preview, and a multi-step profile wizard publishes an initials-avatar header onto the Preview and signs the Digest. The graph has two deep chains (analytics -> preview -> scheduling -> digest -> profile, and analytics -> preview -> groups -> ordering), so early breakage compounds through the ladder.

instruction: 请实现一个用于计算的运算任务网站。网站需要具备输入数学表达式、执行计算和展示结果的功能。用户应当能够输入数学表达式、选择计算类型（例如 'Basic Arithmetic'）、执行计算并查看计算结果。屏幕背景使用 mint cream（薄荷奶油色），组件高亮使用 teal（水鸭蓝）。另外，网站上所有可见的界面内容——包括全部标签、按钮、标题、菜单、提示信息和文案——都必须使用英文；我在这些需求里给出的功能名、页面名和按钮名都是英文的，请务必原样照用，不要翻译。

target_app_summary: The one-page expression calculator has grown into a full computing workbench. The original evaluator is now surrounded by a persistent, filterable calculation history (seeded with seven pinned entries), a user-defined variables library that substitutes named values into expressions live while keeping variable names visible in logged expressions, a save/restore workflow for keeper calculations, and a display-settings engine (decimal places, half-up rounding, scientific notation) whose formatting flows into every surface. On top of the history sit a stats dashboard with tie-aware category rollups and a checkbox-driven report builder with on-screen copyable output; alongside sit a live unit converter and an everything-search page that hunts through history entries, saved calculations, and variables with every keystroke, matching result values as well as expression text. A final app-wide restyle unifies calculator, history, stats, and converter. The feature graph is history-centric: the history feeds formatting, stats, reports, and the live search, with the precision engine forming a second hub, giving chains four turns deep from the base calculator.

global_rules.rule: Every calculated result, on every surface, is displayed in a monospace font prefixed with an equals sign, e.g. '= 42'.
Category tags always render as uppercase pills (ARITHMETIC, SCIENTIFIC, PERCENT) wherever they appear.
Any calculation performed with variables keeps the variable names visible in its expression wherever it is shown or logged — 200*tax stays 200*tax, never the substituted 200*0.0825.

target_app_summary: The matrimonial site has grown from a profile-search-and-chat app into a full matchmaking suite. Discovery got deeper: a live Ashtakoota kundali calculator, a partner-preferences match meter that scores and ranks every member, and a verified-only trust layer stacked onto search. Relationship workflows grew around a pinned seven-member community: an interests hub with received/sent/connection states, a Quick Connect speed-matching night whose mutuals feed straight into connections, and an activity dashboard that rolls all of it up (acceptance rate, average match of connections). Privacy controls with a live self-preview gate messaging by verification or connection status, and a compatibility report builder fuses the kundali rules, match meter, verified badges, and connections into one on-screen shareable document. A royal ivory-maroon-gold restyle mid-way re-skins every surface built so far. The graph runs several chains deep: interests -> speed matching -> dashboard, and calculator/preferences/verification all converge into the final report.

global_rules.rule: Every compatibility or match score anywhere in the app carries a verdict tag: Strong when at least two-thirds of its maximum, Weak when under one-third, Moderate in between.
Any decline, withdraw, or remove action anywhere in the app asks for confirmation before it happens.
Ages are always displayed in the form '27 yrs' everywhere in the app.

target_app_summary: World of Imagination grows from a simple showcase-and-discuss site into a full creative community platform. Discovery gets a real gallery explorer with category/tag cross-filtering and tie-aware sorting over a pinned set of eight works, plus a Spark Score calculator that turns engagement numbers into tiered scores. Social mechanics arrive as a heart/favorites system whose live counts ripple outward into a Weekly Spotlight leaderboard, a per-artist insights dashboard built on the Spark formula, and community-run challenges that crown champions back on the gallery cards. Communities themselves become a multi-page workflow (browse, create with validation, join, post in pinned threads), and everything feeds a notification bell with a filterable activity feed. A late full-app restyle sweeps coral accents, centered serif headings, and a consistent card treatment across every surface. The feature graph fans out from the explorer (T2) into hearts, the calculator prefill, and challenges, with deep chains like explorer to hearts to spotlight and explorer to calculator to artist analytics.

global_rules.rule: Any displayed count of 1000 or more is shown compact with one decimal, like 1.2k, everywhere in the app.
Tags are always rendered with a leading # (e.g. #space) on every surface.
Nothing empty is ever left blank: any empty view or empty result set shows a playful note that mentions a spark.
